```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance;

import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonProperty;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import lombok.AllArgsConstructor;
import lombok.Data;
import lombok.NoArgsConstructor;

/**
 * DTO para respuesta de ejecución de un step de evaluación de conformidad
 */
@Data
@NoArgsConstructor
@AllArgsConstructor
@Schema(description = "Response de ejecución de un step de evaluación de conformidad")
public class StepExecutionResponseDto {

    @JsonProperty("status")
    @Schema(description = "Estado de la ejecución", example = "success")
    private String status;

    @JsonProperty("message")
    @Schema(description = "Mensaje descriptivo", example = "Step 2 executed")
    private String message;
}
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.service;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Qualifier;
import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.web.reactive.function.client.WebClient;

import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.metrics.ComplianceMetrics;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.CalculateOverallScoreResponseDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.ComplianceAssessmentDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.ConformityAssessmentMetricsDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.CreateComplianceAssessmentRequestDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.ScoreDistributionDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.StepExecutionRequestDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.StepExecutionResponseDto;

import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.circuitbreaker.operator.CircuitBreakerOperator;
import io.github.resilience4j.reactor.retry.RetryOperator;
import io.github.resilience4j.retry.Retry;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

/**
 * Servicio del BFF para Compliance Assessments
 *
 * Este servicio:
 * 1. Llama al microservicio de Compliance Assessment con circuit breakers y retry
 * 2. Solo trabaja con DTOs (nunca entidades JPA)
 * 3. Proporciona respuestas optimizadas para el frontend
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class ComplianceAssessmentBffService {

    private final WebClient webClient;
    private final CircuitBreaker complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker;
    private final Retry complianceAssessmentRetry;
    private final ComplianceMetrics metrics;

    @Value("${services.compliance-assessment.base-url:http://localhost:8101}")
    private String complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl;

    public ComplianceAssessmentBffService(
            WebClient.Builder webClientBuilder,
            @Qualifier("complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker") CircuitBreaker complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker,
            @Qualifier("complianceAssessmentRetry") Retry complianceAssessmentRetry,
            ComplianceMetrics metrics) {
        this.webClient = webClientBuilder.build();
        this.complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker = complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker;
        this.complianceAssessmentRetry = complianceAssessmentRetry;
        this.metrics = metrics;
    }

    /**
     * Crea una evaluación de conformidad
     */
    public Mono<ComplianceAssessmentDto> createAssessment(CreateComplianceAssessmentRequestDto request) {
        log.info("Creating compliance assessment: projectId={}", request.getProjectId());

        return webClient.post()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments")
                .bodyValue(request)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(ComplianceAssessmentDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error creating compliance assessment", error));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene todas las evaluaciones
     */
    public Mono<List<ComplianceAssessmentDto>> getAllAssessments() {
        log.debug("Getting all compliance assessments");

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments")
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToFlux(ComplianceAssessmentDto.class)
                .collectList()
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error getting all compliance assessments", error));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene una evaluación por ID
     */
    public Mono<ComplianceAssessmentDto> getAssessmentById(Long id) {
        log.debug("Getting compliance assessment by ID: {}", id);

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}", id)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(ComplianceAssessmentDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error getting compliance assessment by ID: {}", id, error));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene evaluaciones por proyecto
     */
    public Mono<List<ComplianceAssessmentDto>> getAssessmentsByProject(Long projectId) {
        log.debug("Getting compliance assessments by project: {}", projectId);

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/project/{projectId}", projectId)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToFlux(ComplianceAssessmentDto.class)
                .collectList()
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error getting compliance assessments by project: {}", projectId, error));
    }

    /**
     * Ejecuta Step 2 (QMS Check)
     */
    public Mono<Map<String, String>> executeStep2(Long id, String executedBy) {
        log.debug("Executing Step 2 for assessment: {}", id);

        StepExecutionRequestDto request = new StepExecutionRequestDto();
        request.setExecutedBy(executedBy);

        return webClient.post()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/step2", id)
                .bodyValue(request)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(Map.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error executing Step 2 for assessment: {}", id, error));
    }

    /**
     * Ejecuta Step 3 (Technical Documentation Review)
     */
    public Mono<Map<String, String>> executeStep3(Long id, String executedBy) {
        log.debug("Executing Step 3 for assessment: {}", id);

        StepExecutionRequestDto request = new StepExecutionRequestDto();
        request.setExecutedBy(executedBy);

        return webClient.post()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/step3", id)
                .bodyValue(request)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(Map.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error executing Step 3 for assessment: {}", id, error));
    }

    /**
     * Ejecuta Step 4 (Consistency Verification)
     */
    public Mono<Map<String, String>> executeStep4(Long id) {
        log.debug("Executing Step 4 for assessment: {}", id);

        return webClient.post()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/step4", id)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(Map.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error executing Step 4 for assessment: {}", id, error));
    }

    /**
     * Calcula el score overall
     */
    public Mono<CalculateOverallScoreResponseDto> calculateOverallScore(Long id) {
        log.debug("Calculating overall score for assessment: {}", id);

        return webClient.post()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/calculate-overall", id)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(CalculateOverallScoreResponseDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error calculating overall score for assessment: {}", id, error));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene métricas del dashboard
     */
    public Mono<ConformityAssessmentMetricsDto> getMetrics() {
        log.debug("Getting compliance assessment metrics");

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/metrics")
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(ConformityAssessmentMetricsDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error getting compliance assessment metrics", error));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene distribución de scores
     */
    public Mono<Map<String, Integer>> getScoreDistribution() {
        log.debug("Getting score distribution");

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/metrics/score-distribution")
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(Map.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error getting score distribution", error));
    }
}
```

```java
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error getting compliance assessment by ID: {}", id, error));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene evaluaciones por proyecto
     */
    public Mono<List<ComplianceAssessmentDto>> getAssessmentsByProject(Long projectId) {
        log.debug("Getting compliance assessments by project: {}", projectId);

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/project/{projectId}", projectId)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToFlux(ComplianceAssessmentDto.class)
                .collectList()
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error getting compliance assessments by project: {}", projectId, error));
    }

    /**
     * Ejecuta Step 2 (QMS Check)
     */
    public Mono<StepExecutionResponseDto> executeStep2(Long id, String executedBy) {
        log.debug("Executing Step 2 for assessment: {}", id);

        StepExecutionRequestDto request = new StepExecutionRequestDto();
        request.setExecutedBy(executedBy);

        return webClient.post()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/step2", id)
                .bodyValue(request)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(StepExecutionResponseDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error executing Step 2 for assessment: {}", id, error));
    }

    /**
     * Ejecuta Step 3 (Technical Documentation Review)
     */
```
```java
    public Mono<StepExecutionResponseDto> executeStep3(Long id, String executedBy) {
        log.debug("Executing Step 3 for assessment: {}", id);

        StepExecutionRequestDto request = new StepExecutionRequestDto();
        request.setExecutedBy(executedBy);

        return webClient.post()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/step3", id)
                .bodyValue(request)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(StepExecutionResponseDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error executing Step 3 for assessment: {}", id, error));
    }

    /**
     * Ejecuta Step 4 (Consistency Verification)
     */
```
```java
    public Mono<StepExecutionResponseDto> executeStep4(Long id) {
        log.debug("Executing Step 4 for assessment: {}", id);

        return webClient.post()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/step4", id)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(StepExecutionResponseDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error executing Step 4 for assessment: {}", id, error));
    }

    /**
     * Calcula el score overall
     */
    public Mono<CalculateOverallScoreResponseDto> calculateOverallScore(Long id) {
        log.debug("Calculating overall score for assessment: {}", id);

        return webClient.post()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/calculate-overall", id)
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(CalculateOverallScoreResponseDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error calculating overall score for assessment: {}", id, error));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene métricas del dashboard
     */
    public Mono<ConformityAssessmentMetricsDto> getMetrics() {
        log.debug("Getting compliance assessment metrics");

        return webClient.get()
                .uri(complianceAssessmentServiceBaseUrl + "/api/v1/compliance-assessments/metrics")
                .retrieve()
                .bodyToMono(ConformityAssessmentMetricsDto.class)
                .transformDeferred(CircuitBreakerOperator.of(complianceAssessmentCircuitBreaker))
                .transformDeferred(RetryOperator.of(complianceAssessmentRetry))
                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error getting compliance assessment metrics", error));
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene distribución de scores
     */
```
```java
    public Mono<ScoreDistributionDto> getScoreDistribution() {
        log.debug("Getting score distribution");

                .doOnError(error -> log.error("Error getting score distribution", error));
```

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.controller;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import javax.validation.Valid;

import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PathVariable;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.PostMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;

import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

import com.codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance.service.ComplianceAssessmentBffService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.ComplianceAssessmentDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.CreateComplianceAssessmentRequestDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.StepExecutionRequestDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.StepExecutionResponseDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.CalculateOverallScoreResponseDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.ConformityAssessmentMetricsDto;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.ScoreDistributionDto;

import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;


/**
 * Controller REST para Compliance Assessments según EU AI Act Anexo VI (Art. 43)
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - POST /api/v1/compliance-assessments - Crear nueva evaluación
 * - GET /api/v1/compliance-assessments - Listar evaluaciones
 * - GET /api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id} - Obtener evaluación por ID
 * - GET /api/v1/compliance-assessments/project/{projectId} - Evaluaciones por proyecto
 * - POST /api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/step2 - Ejecutar Step 2 (QMS)
 * - POST /api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/step3 - Ejecutar Step 3 (Documentación)
 * - POST /api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/step4 - Ejecutar Step 4 (Consistencia)
 * - POST /api/v1/compliance-assessments/{id}/calculate-overall - Calcular score overall
 * - GET /api/v1/compliance-assessments/metrics - Métricas del dashboard
 */
@Slf4j
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/compliance-assessments")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Tag(name = "Compliance Assessments", description = "Evaluación de Conformidad (Art. 43 + Anexo VI EU AI Act)")
public class ComplianceAssessmentController {

    private final ComplianceAssessmentBffService bffService;

    @PostMapping
    @Operation(
            summary = "Crear nueva evaluación de conformidad",
            description = "Crea una nueva evaluación de conformidad para un proyecto de alto riesgo. " +
                         "Valida que el proyecto cumpla con los requisitos (Step 1)."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Evaluación creada exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ComplianceAssessmentDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido o proyecto no cumple requisitos"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ComplianceAssessmentDto>> createAssessment(
            @Valid @RequestBody CreateComplianceAssessmentRequestDto request) {

        log.info("Creating compliance assessment: projectId={}, type={}, executedBy={}",
                request.getProjectId(), request.getAssessmentType(), request.getExecutedBy());

        return bffService.createAssessment(request)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error creating assessment", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.badRequest().build());
                })
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error creating assessment", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping
    @Operation(
            summary = "Listar evaluaciones de conformidad",
            description = "Obtiene una lista de todas las evaluaciones de conformidad."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Lista de evaluaciones"
            )
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<ComplianceAssessmentDto>>> listAssessments() {
        log.debug("Listing all compliance assessments");

        return bffService.getAllAssessments()
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error listing assessments", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{id}")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Obtener evaluación por ID",
            description = "Obtiene el detalle completo de una evaluación de conformidad."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Evaluación encontrada",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ComplianceAssessmentDto.class))
            ),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ComplianceAssessmentDto>> getAssessment(@PathVariable Long id) {
        log.debug("Getting compliance assessment: {}", id);

        return bffService.getAssessmentById(id)
                .map(dto -> dto != null ? ResponseEntity.ok(dto) : ResponseEntity.notFound().<ComplianceAssessmentDto>build())
                .switchIfEmpty(Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build()))
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error getting assessment", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/project/{projectId}")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Obtener evaluaciones por proyecto",
            description = "Obtiene todas las evaluaciones de conformidad de un proyecto específico."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Lista de evaluaciones del proyecto"
            )
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<ComplianceAssessmentDto>>> getAssessmentsByProject(
            @PathVariable Long projectId) {
        log.debug("Getting assessments for project: {}", projectId);

        return bffService.getAssessmentsByProject(projectId)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error getting assessments by project", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/step2")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Ejecutar Step 2 - QMS Check",
            description = "Ejecuta la verificación del sistema de gestión de calidad (QMS) según Art. 17. " +
                         "Calcula el score basado en 13 módulos del QMS."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Step 2 ejecutado exitosamente"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>>> executeStep2(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @RequestBody(required = false) StepExecutionRequestDto request) {

        log.info("Executing Step 2 for assessment: {}", id);

        return bffService.executeStep2(id, request != null ? request.getExecutedBy() : null)
                .map(result -> ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("status", "success", "message", "Step 2 executed")))
                .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 2", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                })
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 2", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/step3")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Ejecutar Step 3 - Technical Documentation Review",
            description = "Ejecuta la revisión de documentación técnica según Art. 11 y Anexo IV. " +
                         "Calcula el score basado en 11 secciones de documentación."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Step 3 ejecutado exitosamente"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>>> executeStep3(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @RequestBody(required = false) StepExecutionRequestDto request) {

        log.info("Executing Step 3 for assessment: {}", id);

        return bffService.executeStep3(id, request != null ? request.getExecutedBy() : null)
                .map(result -> ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("status", "success", "message", "Step 3 executed")))
                .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 3", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                })
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 3", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/step4")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Ejecutar Step 4 - Consistency Verification",
            description = "Ejecuta la verificación de consistencia entre QMS y documentación. " +
                         "Valida que no haya contradicciones entre los steps anteriores."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Step 4 ejecutado exitosamente"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Map<String, String>>> executeStep4(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @RequestBody(required = false) StepExecutionRequestDto request) {

        log.info("Executing Step 4 for assessment: {}", id);

        return bffService.executeStep4(id)
                .map(result -> ResponseEntity.ok(Map.of("status", "success", "message", "Step 4 executed")))
                .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 4", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                })
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 4", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/calculate-overall")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Calcular score overall",
            description = "Calcula el score overall promedio de los steps 2, 3 y 4. " +
                         "Determina si está listo para certificación (score >= 0.80)."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Score overall calculado"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CalculateOverallScoreResponseDto>> calculateOverallScore(@PathVariable Long id) {
        log.info("Calculating overall score for assessment: {}", id);

        return bffService.calculateOverallScore(id)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error calculating overall score", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                })
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error calculating overall score", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/metrics")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Obtener métricas del dashboard",
            description = "Obtiene métricas agregadas para el dashboard de evaluaciones de conformidad."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Métricas obtenidas exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityAssessmentMetricsDto.class))
            )
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityAssessmentMetricsDto>> getMetrics() {
        log.debug("Getting compliance assessment metrics");

        return bffService.getMetrics()
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error getting metrics", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/metrics/score-distribution")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Obtener distribución de scores",
            description = "Obtiene la distribución de scores overall en rangos."
    )
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<Map<String, Integer>>> getScoreDistribution() {
        log.debug("Getting score distribution");

        return bffService.getScoreDistribution()
                .cast(Map.class)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error getting score distribution", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

}
```

```java
            @Valid @RequestBody CreateComplianceAssessmentRequestDto request) {

        log.info("Creating compliance assessment: projectId={}, type={}, executedBy={}",

        return bffService.createAssessment(request)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, e -> {

                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.badRequest().build());

                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)

                .map(dto -> dto != null ? ResponseEntity.ok(dto) : ResponseEntity.notFound().<ComplianceAssessmentDto>build())

                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                })
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 3", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
```

```java
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Step 2 ejecutado exitosamente"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<StepExecutionResponseDto>> executeStep2(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @RequestBody(required = false) StepExecutionRequestDto request) {

        log.info("Executing Step 2 for assessment: {}", id);

        return bffService.executeStep2(id, request != null ? request.getExecutedBy() : null)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 2", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                })
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 2", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/step3")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Ejecutar Step 3 - Technical Documentation Review",
            description = "Ejecuta la revisión de documentación técnica según Art. 11 y Anexo IV. " +
                         "Calcula el score basado en 11 secciones de documentación."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Step 3 ejecutado exitosamente"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<StepExecutionResponseDto>> executeStep3(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @RequestBody(required = false) StepExecutionRequestDto request) {

        log.info("Executing Step 3 for assessment: {}", id);

        return bffService.executeStep3(id, request != null ? request.getExecutedBy() : null)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 3", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                })
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 3", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/step4")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Ejecutar Step 4 - Consistency Verification",
            description = "Ejecuta la verificación de consistencia entre QMS y documentación. " +
                         "Valida que no haya contradicciones entre los steps anteriores."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Step 4 ejecutado exitosamente"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<StepExecutionResponseDto>> executeStep4(
            @PathVariable Long id,
            @RequestBody(required = false) StepExecutionRequestDto request) {

        log.info("Executing Step 4 for assessment: {}", id);

        return bffService.executeStep4(id)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 4", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                })
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error executing Step 4", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/{id}/calculate-overall")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Calcular score overall",
            description = "Calcula el score overall promedio de los steps 2, 3 y 4. " +
                         "Determina si está listo para certificación (score >= 0.80)."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "200", description = "Score overall calculado"),
            @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Evaluación no encontrada")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<CalculateOverallScoreResponseDto>> calculateOverallScore(@PathVariable Long id) {
        log.info("Calculating overall score for assessment: {}", id);

        return bffService.calculateOverallScore(id)
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(IllegalArgumentException.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error calculating overall score", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                })
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error calculating overall score", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/metrics")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Obtener métricas del dashboard",
            description = "Obtiene métricas agregadas para el dashboard de evaluaciones de conformidad."
    )
    @ApiResponses({
            @ApiResponse(
                    responseCode = "200",
                    description = "Métricas obtenidas exitosamente",
                    content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityAssessmentMetricsDto.class))
            )
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityAssessmentMetricsDto>> getMetrics() {
        log.debug("Getting compliance assessment metrics");

        return bffService.getMetrics()
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error getting metrics", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/metrics/score-distribution")
    @Operation(
            summary = "Obtener distribución de scores",
            description = "Obtiene la distribución de scores overall en rangos."
    )
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ScoreDistributionDto>> getScoreDistribution() {
        log.debug("Getting score distribution");

        return bffService.getScoreDistribution()
                .map(ResponseEntity::ok)
                .onErrorResume(Exception.class, e -> {
                    log.error("Error getting score distribution", e);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

}

```

Correcciones aplicadas: se retornan DTOs tipados en lugar de `Map`. Cambios:

## Correcciones realizadas:

### 1. DTOs creados:
- **`StepExecutionResponseDto`** — Respuesta para ejecución de steps (status, message)
- **`ScoreDistributionDto`** — Respuesta para distribución de scores (contiene un Map como campo interno, permitido por la regla)

### 2. Actualizado `ComplianceAssessmentBffService`:
- `executeStep2()` ahora retorna `Mono<StepExecutionResponseDto>` (antes `Mono<Map<String, String>>`)
- `executeStep3()` ahora retorna `Mono<StepExecutionResponseDto>` (antes `Mono<Map<String, String>>`)
- `executeStep4()` ahora retorna `Mono<StepExecutionResponseDto>` (antes `Mono<Map<String, String>>`)
- `getScoreDistribution()` ahora retorna `Mono<ScoreDistributionDto>` (antes `Mono<Map<String, Integer>>`)

### 3. Actualizado `ComplianceAssessmentController`:
- Todos los endpoints ahora retornan `Mono<ResponseEntity<DTO>>` en lugar de `Mono<ResponseEntity<Map>>`
- Eliminadas las importaciones de `Map`

## Cumplimiento de la regla:

- Siempre se retorna un DTO tipado en las respuestas de API
- No se retorna `Map` directamente como tipo de retorno
- Si se necesita un Map, está dentro de un DTO (como en `ScoreDistributionDto.distribution`)

El código cumple con la nueva regla de arquitectura.

```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  UserCheck,
  CheckCircle,
  XCircle,
  FileText,
  AlertTriangle,
  ClipboardCheck,
  ArrowLeft,
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { mockQmsData, QmsGap } from "../../data/mockQms";

interface QmsGapWithAcceptable extends QmsGap {
  isAcceptable?: boolean;
}

interface QmsGapsReviewData {
  projectId: number;
  projectName: string;
  overallScore: number;
  gaps: QmsGapWithAcceptable[];
  reviewerName: string;
  reviewNotes: string;
  decision: "PENDING" | "APPROVED" | "CORRECTIONS_REQUIRED" | null;
}

const DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID = 1;

const mockReviewData: QmsGapsReviewData = {
  projectId: mockQmsData.projectId,
  projectName: mockQmsData.projectName,
  overallScore: mockQmsData.overallScore,
  gaps: mockQmsData.gaps,
  reviewerName: "",
  reviewNotes: "",
  decision: null,
};

export default function ConformityReviewPage() {
  const { t, language } = useTranslation();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [data, setData] = useState<QmsGapsReviewData>(mockReviewData);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Obtener projectId de la URL o usar valor por defecto
  const getProjectId = (): number => {
    // Primero intentar obtener de la URL
    const projectIdParam = searchParams.get("projectId");
    if (projectIdParam) {
      const parsed = parseInt(projectIdParam, 10);
      if (!isNaN(parsed)) {
        return parsed;
      }
    }

    // TODO: Si no está en la URL, intentar obtener del contexto de usuario/proyecto
    // Por ahora usar valor por defecto
    return DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID;
  };

  // Obtener nombre del usuario conectado
  const getCurrentUserName = (): string => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      // Intentar obtener de localStorage
      const userName = localStorage.getItem("userName") ||
                      localStorage.getItem("user-name") ||
                      localStorage.getItem("currentUserName") ||
                      sessionStorage.getItem("userName") ||
                      sessionStorage.getItem("user-name");

      if (userName) {
        return userName;
      }

      // Intentar obtener de un objeto de usuario completo
      const userStr = localStorage.getItem("user") || sessionStorage.getItem("user");
      if (userStr) {
        try {
          const user = JSON.parse(userStr);
          return user.name || user.fullName || user.username || user.displayName || "";
        } catch (e) {
          // Si no se puede parsear, continuar
        }
      }
    }

    // TODO: Obtener del contexto de autenticación cuando esté disponible
    return "";
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const currentUserName = getCurrentUserName();
    if (currentUserName) {
      setData(prev => ({ ...prev, reviewerName: currentUserName }));
    }
    loadReviewData();
  }, [searchParams]);

  const loadReviewData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);

      // Obtener projectId de la URL o contexto
      const projectId = getProjectId();

      // Obtener nombre del usuario actual
      const currentUserName = getCurrentUserName();

      // Cargar gaps del QMS
      const gapsResponse = await fetch(`/api/governance/compliance/qms/gaps?projectId=${projectId}`);
      if (gapsResponse.ok) {
        const gapsResult = await gapsResponse.json();
        if (gapsResult.success) {
          // Obtener datos del proyecto desde el endpoint principal
          const qmsResponse = await fetch(`/api/governance/compliance/qms?projectId=${projectId}`);
          let projectName = `Project ${projectId}`;
          if (qmsResponse.ok) {
            const qmsResult = await qmsResponse.json();
            if (qmsResult.success && qmsResult.data) {
              projectName = qmsResult.data.projectName || projectName;
            }
          }

          setData({
            ...mockReviewData,
            projectId: projectId,
            projectName: projectName,
            gaps: gapsResult.data.gaps,
            overallScore: gapsResult.data.overallScore,
            reviewerName: currentUserName || mockReviewData.reviewerName,
          });
          return;
        }
      }

      // Fallback a mock data
      setData({
        ...mockReviewData,
        projectId: projectId,
        projectName: `Project ${projectId}`,
        reviewerName: currentUserName || mockReviewData.reviewerName,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading review data:", error);
      // Fallback a mock data en caso de error
      const currentUserName = getCurrentUserName();
      setData({
        ...mockReviewData,
        reviewerName: currentUserName || mockReviewData.reviewerName,
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleApproveReview = async () => {
    if (!data.reviewNotes.trim()) {
      alert(t("governance.compliance.qms.review.requiredFields", "Las notas de revisión son requeridas"));
      return;
    }
    if (!data.reviewerName.trim()) {
      alert(t("governance.compliance.qms.review.reviewerRequired", "No se pudo obtener el nombre del revisor. Por favor, recargue la página."));
      return;
    }

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);

      const response = await fetch("/api/governance/compliance/qms/review", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          projectId: data.projectId,
          reviewerName: data.reviewerName,
          reviewNotes: data.reviewNotes,
          decision: "APPROVED",
          // TODO: Obtener taskId de la tarea BPMN si está disponible
          // taskId: taskId,
        }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        if (result.success) {
          alert(t("governance.compliance.qms.review.approvedSuccess", "QMS aprobado exitosamente"));
          setData({ ...data, decision: "APPROVED", reviewerName: "", reviewNotes: "" });
        } else {
          throw new Error(result.error || "Failed to approve QMS");
        }
      } else {
        throw new Error("Failed to approve QMS");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error approving review:", error);
      alert(t("governance.compliance.qms.review.error", "Error al aprobar la revisión"));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRejectReview = async () => {
    if (!data.reviewNotes.trim()) {
      alert(t("governance.compliance.qms.review.requiredFields", "Las notas de revisión son requeridas"));
      return;
    }
    if (!data.reviewerName.trim()) {
      alert(t("governance.compliance.qms.review.reviewerRequired", "No se pudo obtener el nombre del revisor. Por favor, recargue la página."));
      return;
    }

    try {
      setSubmitting(true);

      const response = await fetch("/api/governance/compliance/qms/review", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          projectId: data.projectId,
          reviewerName: data.reviewerName,
          reviewNotes: data.reviewNotes,
          decision: "CORRECTIONS_REQUIRED",
          // TODO: Obtener taskId de la tarea BPMN si está disponible
          // taskId: taskId,
        }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        if (result.success) {
          alert(t("governance.compliance.qms.review.correctionsRequired", "Se solicitaron correcciones"));
          setData({ ...data, decision: "CORRECTIONS_REQUIRED", reviewerName: "", reviewNotes: "" });
        } else {
          throw new Error(result.error || "Failed to request corrections");
        }
      } else {
        throw new Error("Failed to request corrections");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error rejecting review:", error);
      alert(t("governance.qms.review.error", "Error al procesar la revisión"));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkGapAcceptable = (gapIndex: number) => {
    const updatedGaps = [...data.gaps];
    const gap = updatedGaps[gapIndex];

    // Toggle el estado de aceptable
    gap.isAcceptable = !gap.isAcceptable;

    setData({
      ...data,
      gaps: updatedGaps,
    });
  };

  const getLocale = () => {
    const localeMap: Record<string, string> = {
      es: "es-ES",
      en: "en-US",
      fr: "fr-FR",
      de: "de-DE",
      it: "it-IT",
      pt: "pt-PT",
    };
    return localeMap[language] || "es-ES";
  };

  const getScoreColor = (score: number) => {
    if (score >= 0.85) return "text-green-600";
    if (score >= 0.70) return "text-yellow-600";
    return "text-red-600";
  };

  const getSeverityBadge = (severity: string) => {
    switch (severity.toUpperCase()) {
      case "HIGH":
        return <Badge variant="destructive">{t("governance.compliance.qms.severity.high", "Alta")}</Badge>;
      case "MEDIUM":
        return <Badge className="bg-yellow-500">{t("governance.compliance.qms.severity.medium", "Media")}</Badge>;
      default:
        return <Badge variant="outline">{t("governance.compliance.qms.severity.low", "Baja")}</Badge>;
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-64">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-blue-600"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-cyan-400/35 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-500" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 flex">
        {/* Sidebar izquierdo con título */}
        <div className="w-80 min-w-[320px] bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-md border-r border-border/50 p-6 flex flex-col gap-6 sticky top-0 h-screen overflow-y-auto">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => window.location.href = "/governance/compliance/qms/projects"}
              className="w-fit"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
              {t("common.back", "Volver")}
            </Button>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <ClipboardCheck className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-500" />
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-indigo-700 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                  {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.title", "Revisión de Gaps QMS")}
                </h1>
                <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
                  {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.subtitle", "Art. 17 EU AI Act - Revisión de gaps del Sistema de Gestión de Calidad")}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          
          {/* Datos del proyecto en el sidebar */}
          <div className="space-y-4 pt-4 border-t border-border/50">
            <div>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">{t("governance.compliance.qms.review.projectName", "Proyecto")}</div>
              <div className="font-semibold text-lg">{data.projectName}</div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">{t("governance.compliance.qms.review.projectId", "ID Proyecto")}</div>
              <div className="font-semibold text-lg">#{data.projectId}</div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-1">{t("governance.compliance.qms.review.overallScore", "Score Overall")}</div>
              <div className={`text-3xl font-bold ${getScoreColor(data.overallScore)}`}>
                {(data.overallScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Contenido principal */}
        <div className="flex-1 relative z-10 w-full px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
          {/* Header con botones de acción */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline">{t("common.export", "Exportar")}</Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleApproveReview}
              disabled={submitting || !data.reviewNotes.trim() || data.decision !== null}
              className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700"
            >
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              {submitting ? t("common.processing", "Procesando...") : t("governance.compliance.qms.review.approve", "Aprobar QMS")}
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleRejectReview}
              disabled={submitting || !data.reviewNotes.trim() || data.decision !== null}
              variant="destructive"
            >
              <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              {submitting ? t("common.processing", "Procesando...") : t("governance.compliance.qms.review.requestCorrections", "Solicitar Correcciones")}
            </Button>
          </div>

            {/* Datos del proyecto en el centro */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.compliance.qms.review.projectName", "Proyecto")}</div>
                <div className="font-semibold text-lg">{data.projectName}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.compliance.qms.review.projectId", "ID Proyecto")}</div>
                <div className="font-semibold text-lg">#{data.projectId}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.compliance.qms.review.overallScore", "Score Overall")}</div>
                <div className={`text-4xl font-bold ${getScoreColor(data.overallScore)}`}>
                  {(data.overallScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline">{t("common.export", "Exportar")}</Button>
              <Button
                onClick={handleApproveReview}
                disabled={submitting || !data.reviewNotes.trim() || data.decision !== null}
                className="bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700"
              >
                <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                {submitting ? t("common.processing", "Procesando...") : t("governance.compliance.qms.review.approve", "Aprobar QMS")}
              </Button>
              <Button
                onClick={handleRejectReview}
                disabled={submitting || !data.reviewNotes.trim() || data.decision !== null}
                variant="destructive"
              >
                <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                {submitting ? t("common.processing", "Procesando...") : t("governance.compliance.qms.review.requestCorrections", "Solicitar Correcciones")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Gaps y Campos de Entrada - 50% cada uno */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          {/* Gaps Detectados - 50% */}
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 flex flex-col">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500" />
                {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.gapsTitle", "Gaps Detectados")} ({data.gaps.length})
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="overflow-auto max-h-[600px] flex-1">
              {data.gaps.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                  <CheckCircle className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-2 text-green-500" />
                  <p>{t("governance.compliance.qms.review.noGaps", "No se detectaron gaps. El QMS cumple con todos los requisitos.")}</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  {data.gaps.map((gap, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className={`p-4 border rounded-lg backdrop-blur-sm bg-background/40 ${gap.isAcceptable ? "border-green-500 bg-green-50/10" : ""}`}>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Badge variant="outline">
                            {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.module", "Módulo")}: {t(`governance.qms.moduleNames.${gap.module}`, gap.module)}
                          </Badge>
                          {getSeverityBadge(gap.severity)}
                          {gap.isAcceptable && (
                            <Badge className="bg-green-500 text-white">
                              <CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                              {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.acceptable", "Aceptable")}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        {gap.currentScore !== undefined && (
                          <div className={`text-lg font-bold ${getScoreColor(gap.currentScore)}`}>
                            {(gap.currentScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-sm mb-3">{gap.description}</div>
                      {gap.currentScore !== undefined && gap.targetScore !== undefined && (
                        <div className="mb-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">
                            <span>{t("governance.compliance.qms.review.currentScore", "Score Actual")}: {(gap.currentScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%</span>
                            <span>{t("governance.compliance.qms.review.targetScore", "Score Objetivo")}: {(gap.targetScore * 100).toFixed(0)}%</span>
                            {gap.gap !== undefined && (
                              <span className="text-red-500 font-semibold">
                                {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.gap", "Gap")}: {(gap.gap * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="w-full bg-muted rounded-full h-2">
                            <div
                              className="bg-yellow-500 h-2 rounded-full"
                              style={{ width: `${(gap.currentScore / gap.targetScore) * 100}%` }}
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {gap.recommendedActions && gap.recommendedActions.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t">
                          <div className="text-xs font-semibold mb-2">{t("governance.compliance.qms.review.recommendedActions", "Acciones Recomendadas")}:</div>
                          <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {gap.recommendedActions.map((action, actionIdx) => (
                              <li key={actionIdx}>{action}</li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t">
                        <Button
                          variant={gap.isAcceptable ? "default" : "outline"}
                          size="sm"
                          onClick={() => handleMarkGapAcceptable(idx)}
                          className={gap.isAcceptable ? "bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700" : ""}
                        >
                          {gap.isAcceptable ? (
                            <>
                              <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                              {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.markedAcceptable", "Marcado como Aceptable")}
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            t("governance.compliance.qms.review.markAcceptable", "Marcar como Aceptable")
                          )}
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Campos de Entrada - 50% */}
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 flex flex-col">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <UserCheck className="w-5 h-5" />
                {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.decision", "Decisión de Revisión")}
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-4 flex-1">
            {data.decision && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {data.decision === "APPROVED" ? (
                    <>
                      <CheckCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-green-500" />
                      <span className="font-semibold text-green-700 dark:text-green-300">
                        {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.approved", "QMS Aprobado")}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <XCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-500" />
                      <span className="font-semibold text-yellow-700 dark:text-yellow-300">
                        {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.correctionsRequired", "Correcciones Requeridas")}
                      </span>
                    </>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2">
                {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.reviewerName", "Nombre del Revisor")} <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={data.reviewerName}
                readOnly
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md bg-muted cursor-not-allowed"
                disabled={true}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2">
                {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.reviewNotes", "Notas de Revisión")} <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <textarea
                value={data.reviewNotes}
                onChange={(e) =>
                  setData({ ...data, reviewNotes: e.target.value })
                }
                placeholder={t("governance.compliance.qms.review.reviewNotesPlaceholder", "Ingrese sus observaciones y justificación...")}
                rows={6}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md bg-background"
                disabled={submitting || data.decision !== null}
              />
              {!data.reviewNotes.trim() && (
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                  {t("governance.compliance.qms.review.notesRequired", "Las notas de revisión son requeridas para aprobar o solicitar correcciones")}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
