package com.codeflowx.govern.conformity.exception;

import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.core.ErrorResponseDto;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;

/**
 * Manejador global de excepciones para el servicio Conformity Declaration
 *
 * IMPORTANTE: Siempre retorna DTOs tipados, nunca Map según la normativa de arquitectura.
 */
@RestControllerAdvice
@Slf4j
public class GlobalExceptionHandler {

    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ErrorResponseDto>> handleIllegalArgumentException(IllegalArgumentException ex) {
        log.warn("Illegal argument: {}", ex.getMessage());

        ErrorResponseDto error = ErrorResponseDto.of(
            HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(),
            "Bad Request",
            ex.getMessage(),
            "/api/v1/conformity-declaration"
        );

        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(error));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalStateException.class)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ErrorResponseDto>> handleIllegalStateException(IllegalStateException ex) {
        log.warn("Illegal state: {}", ex.getMessage());

        ErrorResponseDto error = ErrorResponseDto.of(
            HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(),
            "Bad Request",
            ex.getMessage(),
            "/api/v1/conformity-declaration"
        );

        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(error));
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ErrorResponseDto>> handleGenericException(Exception ex) {
        log.error("Unexpected error in Conformity Declaration service", ex);

        ErrorResponseDto error = ErrorResponseDto.of(
            HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.value(),
            "Internal Server Error",
            "An unexpected error occurred",
            "/api/v1/conformity-declaration"
        );

        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).body(error));
    }
}

```markdown
# CodeflowX Governance Conformity Declaration Service

Microservicio REST reactivo para EU Declaration of Conformity según EU AI Act Annex V (Art. 48).

## Descripción

Este microservicio implementa la gestión de declaraciones de conformidad (Conformity Declaration) según el Artículo 48 y Anexo V del EU AI Act. Las declaraciones de conformidad son obligatorias para sistemas de IA de alto riesgo y deben incluir:

- Información del proveedor
- Información del sistema de IA
- Base de conformidad (Anexo VI - evaluación interna o Anexo VII - evaluación por organismo notificado)
- Cumplimiento por artículo (Art. 9-15)
- Firma digital (opcional, para eIDAS)

## Tecnologías

- **Spring Boot 3.5.8** con **WebFlux** (Reactivo)
- **Spring Data JPA** (Síncrono, envuelto en Mono)
- **PostgreSQL** (Base de datos)
- **OpenAPI/Swagger** (Documentación)
- **Actuator** (Health checks y métricas)

## Endpoints

### GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/projects
Lista proyectos con declaraciones de conformidad.

**Query Params:**
- `page` (int, default: 0)
- `size` (int, default: 20)
- `hasDeclarations` (String, optional: "true", "false", "all")
- `search` (String, optional)

**Respuesta:**
```json
{
  "projects": [...],
  "statistics": {
    "totalProjects": 10,
    "projectsWithDeclarations": 5,
    "totalDeclarations": 12,
    "totalSigned": 8,
    "totalDrafts": 4
  },
  "pagination": {...}
}
```

### GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/manager?projectId={id}
Obtiene datos del manager de declaraciones para un proyecto.

**Query Params:**
- `projectId` (Long, requerido)

**Respuesta:**
```json
{
  "projectId": 1,
  "projectName": "Healthcare AI Project",
  "assessments": [...],
  "declarations": [...],
  "preview": null
}
```

### POST /api/v1/conformity-declaration
Crea una nueva declaración de conformidad.

**Body:**
```json
{
  "assessmentId": 1,
  "providerName": "TechCorp Medical",
  "aiSystemName": "Healthcare Diagnostics AI",
  "providerAddress": "...",
  "providerCountry": "Spain",
  "aiSystemType": "HIGH_RISK",
  "riskCategory": "HIGH_RISK"
}
```

### POST /api/v1/conformity-declaration/sign
Firma una declaración de conformidad.

**Body:**
```json
{
  "declarationId": 1,
  "signedBy": "John Doe",
  "digitalSignature": "optional-eidas-signature"
}
```

### GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/{id}
Obtiene una declaración por ID.

### GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/project/{projectId}
Obtiene todas las declaraciones de un proyecto.

### GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/{id}/pdf
Descarga el PDF de una declaración.

## Configuración

### Variables de Entorno

```bash
SERVER_PORT=8099
DATASOURCE_URL=jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/nocode
DATASOURCE_USERNAME=nocode
DATASOURCE_PASSWORD=nocode
SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE=dev
```

### application.yml

El servicio se configura mediante `application.yml` con soporte para múltiples perfiles (dev, prod, test).

## Arquitectura

```
Frontend (Next.js)
    ↓ HTTP
BFF (codeflowx.govern.bff.compliance)
    ↓ HTTP/WebClient (Reactivo)
Conformity Declaration Service (este microservicio) [Reactivo - WebFlux]
    ↓ Mono.fromCallable()
ConformityDeclarationBusinessService [Síncrono - JPA]
    ↓
Repositorio (JPA)
    ↓
Entidad JPA (ConformityDeclaration)
```

## Compilación y Ejecución

```bash
# Compilar
mvn clean install

# Ejecutar
mvn spring-boot:run

# O ejecutar el JAR
java -jar target/codeflowx-governance-conformity-declaration-service-1.0.0.jar
```

## Swagger UI

Una vez iniciado el servicio, acceder a:
- **Swagger UI:** http://localhost:8099/swagger-ui.html
- **API Docs:** http://localhost:8099/api-docs

## Health Check

- **Health:** http://localhost:8099/actuator/health
- **Metrics:** http://localhost:8099/actuator/metrics
- **Prometheus:** http://localhost:8099/actuator/prometheus

## Dependencias

- `codeflowx.govern.business` - Servicios de negocio
- `codeflowx.govern.repository` - Repositorios JPA
- `codeflowx.govern.nocode.entitys` - Entidades JPA
- `codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos` - DTOs compartidos

## Notas

- Todos los endpoints son **reactivos** (retornan `Mono<ResponseEntity<T>>`)
- Las operaciones síncronas (JPA) se envuelven en `Mono.fromCallable()` con `Schedulers.boundedElastic()`
- El servicio usa el patrón establecido en `codeflowx-governance-qms-service`

## Referencias

- **Art. 48 EU AI Act:** EU Declaration of Conformity
- **Annex V EU AI Act:** Content of the EU Declaration of Conformity
- **Documentación Arquitectura:** `docs/ARQUITECTURA_FRONTEND.md`

Ajustando el controller para usar correctamente los métodos existentes:


```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.conformity.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.ConformityDeclarationBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.ComplianceAssessmentBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.governance.ConformityDeclaration;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.ComplianceAssessment;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.*;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.ProjectRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.projects.Project;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para operaciones de Conformity Declaration
 * según EU AI Act Annex V (Art. 48)
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/projects - Lista proyectos con declaraciones
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/manager - Datos del manager
 * - POST /api/v1/conformity-declaration - Crear declaración
 * - POST /api/v1/conformity-declaration/sign - Firmar declaración
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/{id} - Obtener por ID
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/project/{projectId} - Por proyecto
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/{id}/pdf - Descargar PDF
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/conformity-declaration")
@Tag(name = "Conformity Declaration", description = "Operaciones para EU Declaration of Conformity (Art. 48 EU AI Act)")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class ConformityDeclarationController {

    private final ConformityDeclarationBusinessService declarationBusinessService;
    private final ComplianceAssessmentBusinessService assessmentBusinessService;
    private final ProjectRepository projectRepository;

    @GetMapping("/projects")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar proyectos con declaraciones de conformidad",
        description = "Obtiene una lista paginada de proyectos con información resumida de declaraciones de conformidad"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de proyectos obtenida exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto>> listProjects(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "20") int size,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String hasDeclarations,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        
        log.info("Listing projects with conformity declarations: page={}, size={}, hasDeclarations={}, search={}",
                page, size, hasDeclarations, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // Obtener todos los proyectos (simplificado, en producción usar paginación)
                List<Project> projects = projectRepository.findAll();
                
                // Filtrar por búsqueda
                if (search != null && !search.isEmpty()) {
                    projects = projects.stream()
                            .filter(p -> p.getPrjname() != null && 
                                    p.getPrjname().toLowerCase().contains(search.toLowerCase()))
                            .collect(Collectors.toList());
                }

                // Convertir a DTOs con estadísticas
                List<ConformityDeclarationProjectSummaryDto> projectDtos = projects.stream()
                        .map(this::convertToProjectSummaryDto)
                        .filter(dto -> {
                            // Filtrar por hasDeclarations
                            if (hasDeclarations == null || hasDeclarations.isEmpty() || "all".equals(hasDeclarations)) {
                                return true;
                            }
                            boolean hasDecls = dto.getHasDeclarations();
                            return "true".equals(hasDeclarations) ? hasDecls : !hasDecls;
                        })
                        .skip(page * size)
                        .limit(size)
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                // Calcular estadísticas totales
                long totalProjects = projects.size();
                long projectsWithDeclarations = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getTotal() > 0 ? 1 : 0;
                        })
                        .sum();
                
                long totalDeclarations = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getTotal();
                        })
                        .sum();
                
                long totalSigned = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getSigned();
                        })
                        .sum();
                
                long totalDrafts = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getDrafts();
                        })
                        .sum();

                // Calcular paginación
                int totalElements = projects.size();
                int totalPages = (int) Math.ceil((double) totalElements / size);

                ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto response = 
                        ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto.builder()
                                .projects(projectDtos)
                                .statistics(ConformityDeclarationProjectsStatisticsDto.builder()
                                        .totalProjects(totalProjects)
                                        .projectsWithDeclarations(projectsWithDeclarations)
                                        .totalDeclarations(totalDeclarations)
                                        .totalSigned(totalSigned)
                                        .totalDrafts(totalDrafts)
                                        .build())
                                .pagination(ConformityDeclarationPaginationDto.builder()
                                        .page(page)
                                        .size(size)
                                        .totalPages(totalPages)
                                        .totalElements((long) totalElements)
                                        .build())
                                .build();

                return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error listing projects with conformity declarations", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/manager")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener datos del manager de declaraciones",
        description = "Retorna los datos completos para el manager de declaraciones de un proyecto"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Datos del manager obtenidos exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "projectId es requerido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Proyecto no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto>> getManagerData(
            @RequestParam Long projectId) {
        
        log.info("Getting manager data for project: {}", projectId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // Obtener proyecto
                Project project = projectRepository.findById(projectId)
                        .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Project not found: " + projectId));

                // Obtener assessments del proyecto
                List<ComplianceAssessment> assessments = assessmentBusinessService.getAllAssessments()
                        .stream()
                        .filter(a -> a.getProject() != null && 
                                a.getProject().getIdxproject().equals(projectId))
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                // Obtener declaraciones del proyecto
                List<ConformityDeclaration> declarations = 
                        declarationBusinessService.getDeclarationsByProject(projectId);

                // Convertir assessments a DTOs
                List<ComplianceAssessmentDto> assessmentDtos = assessments.stream()
                        .map(this::convertAssessmentToDto)
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                // Convertir declaraciones a DTOs
                List<ConformityDeclarationDto> declarationDtos = declarations.stream()
                        .map(decl -> convertDeclarationToDto(decl, project))
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto data = 
                        ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto.builder()
                                .projectId(projectId)
                                .projectName(project.getPrjname())
                                .assessments(assessmentDtos)
                                .declarations(declarationDtos)
                                .preview(null) // Se genera cuando se selecciona un assessment
                                .build();

                return ResponseEntity.ok(data);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting manager data for project: {}", projectId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping
    @Operation(
        summary = "Crear nueva declaración de conformidad",
        description = "Crea una nueva declaración de conformidad basada en un assessment"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Declaración creada exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationDto>> createDeclaration(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<CreateConformityDeclarationRequestDto> requestMono) {
        
        return requestMono
                .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Creating conformity declaration for assessment: {}", 
                        request.getAssessmentId()))
                .flatMap(request -> {
                    if (request.getAssessmentId() == null) {
                        log.warn("Assessment ID is required");
                        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<ConformityDeclarationDto>badRequest().build());
                    }

                    return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                            // Obtener assessment para obtener información del proyecto
                            ComplianceAssessment assessment = assessmentBusinessService
                                    .getAssessmentById(request.getAssessmentId());
                            if (assessment == null) {
                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Assessment not found: " + request.getAssessmentId());
                            }

                            Project project = assessment.getProject();
                            if (project == null) {
                                throw new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Assessment has no associated project");
                            }

                            // Crear declaración
                            ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                                    .createDeclaration(
                                            request.getAssessmentId(),
                                            request.getProviderName() != null ? request.getProviderName() : 
                                                    "Provider Name",
                                            request.getAiSystemName() != null ? request.getAiSystemName() : 
                                                    "AI System Name");

                            // Actualizar campos adicionales si se proporcionan
                            if (request.getProviderAddress() != null) {
                                declaration.setProviderAddress(request.getProviderAddress());
                            }
                            if (request.getProviderCountry() != null) {
                                declaration.setProviderCountry(request.getProviderCountry());
                            }
                            if (request.getProviderContact() != null) {
                                declaration.setProviderContact(request.getProviderContact());
                            }
                            if (request.getAiSystemType() != null) {
                                declaration.setAiSystemType(request.getAiSystemType());
                            }
                            if (request.getAiSystemVersion() != null) {
                                declaration.setAiSystemVersion(request.getAiSystemVersion());
                            }
                            if (request.getIntendedPurpose() != null) {
                                declaration.setIntendedPurpose(request.getIntendedPurpose());
                            }
                            if (request.getRiskCategory() != null) {
                                declaration.setRiskCategory(request.getRiskCategory());
                            }

                            // Convertir a DTO
                            ConformityDeclarationDto dto = convertDeclarationToDto(declaration, project);
                            return ResponseEntity.ok(dto);
                        })
                        .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic());
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error creating conformity declaration", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/sign")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Firmar declaración de conformidad",
        description = "Firma una declaración de conformidad en estado DRAFT"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Declaración firmada exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido o declaración no está en DRAFT"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Declaración no encontrada"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationDto>> signDeclaration(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<SignConformityDeclarationRequestDto> requestMono) {
        
        return requestMono
                .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Signing conformity declaration: {} by: {}", 
                        request.getDeclarationId(), request.getSignedBy()))
                .flatMap(request -> {
                    if (request.getDeclarationId() == null) {
                        log.warn("Declaration ID is required");
                        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<ConformityDeclarationDto>badRequest().build());
                    }

                    return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                            // Firmar declaración
                            ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                                    .signDeclaration(
                                            request.getDeclarationId(),
                                            request.getSignedBy(),
                                            request.getDigitalSignature());

                            // Obtener proyecto desde el assessment
                            Project project = declaration.getAssessment() != null ? 
                                    declaration.getAssessment().getProject() : null;

                            // Convertir a DTO
                            ConformityDeclarationDto dto = convertDeclarationToDto(declaration, project);
                            return ResponseEntity.ok(dto);
                        })
                        .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic());
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error signing conformity declaration", error);
                    if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.badRequest().build());
                    }
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{declarationId}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener declaración por ID",
        description = "Retorna una declaración de conformidad por su ID"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Declaración obtenida exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Declaración no encontrada"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationDto>> getDeclarationById(
            @PathVariable Long declarationId) {
        
        log.info("Getting conformity declaration: {}", declarationId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                        .getDeclarationById(declarationId)
                        .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Declaration not found: " + declarationId));

                Project project = declaration.getAssessment() != null ? 
                        declaration.getAssessment().getProject() : null;

                ConformityDeclarationDto dto = convertDeclarationToDto(declaration, project);
                return ResponseEntity.ok(dto);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting conformity declaration: {}", declarationId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/project/{projectId}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener declaraciones por proyecto",
        description = "Retorna todas las declaraciones de conformidad de un proyecto"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de declaraciones obtenida exitosamente"
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<ConformityDeclarationDto>>> getDeclarationsByProject(
            @PathVariable Long projectId) {
        
        log.info("Getting conformity declarations for project: {}", projectId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // Obtener proyecto
                Project project = projectRepository.findById(projectId)
                        .orElse(null);

                // Obtener declaraciones
                List<ConformityDeclaration> declarations = 
                        declarationBusinessService.getDeclarationsByProject(projectId);

                // Convertir a DTOs
                List<ConformityDeclarationDto> dtos = declarations.stream()
                        .map(decl -> convertDeclarationToDto(decl, project))
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                return ResponseEntity.ok(dtos);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting declarations for project: {}", projectId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{declarationId}/pdf")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Descargar PDF de declaración",
        description = "Descarga el PDF generado de una declaración de conformidad"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "PDF descargado exitosamente"
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Declaración no encontrada o PDF no generado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<byte[]>> downloadDeclarationPdf(
            @PathVariable Long declarationId) {
        
        log.info("Downloading PDF for conformity declaration: {}", declarationId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                        .getDeclarationById(declarationId)
                        .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Declaration not found: " + declarationId));

                if (declaration.getPdfPath() == null || declaration.getPdfPath().isEmpty()) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "PDF not generated for declaration: " + declarationId);
                }

                // TODO: Implementar lectura del archivo PDF desde el path
                // Por ahora retornamos un array vacío
                byte[] pdfBytes = new byte[0];
                
                return ResponseEntity.ok()
                        .header("Content-Type", "application/pdf")
                        .header("Content-Disposition", 
                                "attachment; filename=declaration_" + declarationId + ".pdf")
                        .body(pdfBytes);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error downloading PDF for declaration: {}", declarationId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException || error instanceof IllegalStateException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    private ConformityDeclarationProjectSummaryDto convertToProjectSummaryDto(Project project) {
        ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(project.getIdxproject());

        // Obtener última declaración
        ConformityDeclaration lastDeclaration = declarationBusinessService
                .getDeclarationsByProject(project.getIdxproject())
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);

        return ConformityDeclarationProjectSummaryDto.builder()
                .projectId(project.getIdxproject())
                .projectName(project.getPrjname())
                .description(project.getPrjdescription())
                .totalDeclarations(stats.getTotal().intValue())
                .signedDeclarations(stats.getSigned().intValue())
                .draftDeclarations(stats.getDrafts().intValue())
                .latestDeclarationDate(lastDeclaration != null && lastDeclaration.getCreatedAt() != null ?
                        lastDeclaration.getCreatedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .latestDeclarationStatus(lastDeclaration != null ? lastDeclaration.getStatus() : null)
                .latestDeclarationVersion(lastDeclaration != null ? lastDeclaration.getAiSystemVersion() : null)
                .hasDeclarations(stats.getTotal() > 0)
                .build();
    }

    private ComplianceAssessmentDto convertAssessmentToDto(ComplianceAssessment assessment) {
        ComplianceAssessmentDto dto = new ComplianceAssessmentDto();
        dto.setIdxcomplianceassessment(assessment.getIdxcomplianceassessment());
        dto.setIdxproject(assessment.getProject() != null ? 
                assessment.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setComassessmenttype(assessment.getComassessmenttype());
        dto.setComassessmentdate(assessment.getComassessmentdate() != null ?
                assessment.getComassessmentdate().toLocalDateTime() : null);
        dto.setComassessmentname(assessment.getComassessmentname());
        dto.setComoverallscore(assessment.getComoverallscore());
        dto.setComreadyforcertification(assessment.getComreadyforcertification());
        return dto;
    }

    private ConformityDeclarationDto convertDeclarationToDto(ConformityDeclaration declaration, 
                                                             Project project) {
        return ConformityDeclarationDto.builder()
                .idxDeclaration(declaration.getIdxDeclaration())
                .providerName(declaration.getProviderName())
                .providerAddress(declaration.getProviderAddress())
                .providerCountry(declaration.getProviderCountry())
                .providerContact(declaration.getProviderContact())
                .aiSystemName(declaration.getAiSystemName())
                .aiSystemType(declaration.getAiSystemType())
                .aiSystemVersion(declaration.getAiSystemVersion())
                .intendedPurpose(declaration.getIntendedPurpose())
                .riskCategory(declaration.getRiskCategory())
                .conformityBasis(declaration.getConformityBasis())
                .appliedStandards(declaration.getAppliedStandards())
                .harmonizedStandards(declaration.getHarmonizedStandards())
                .art9RiskManagement(declaration.getArt9RiskManagement())
                .art10DataGovernance(declaration.getArt10DataGovernance())
                .art11Documentation(declaration.getArt11Documentation())
                .art12RecordKeeping(declaration.getArt12RecordKeeping())
                .art13Transparency(declaration.getArt13Transparency())
                .art14HumanOversight(declaration.getArt14HumanOversight())
                .art15Accuracy(declaration.getArt15Accuracy())
                .overallComplianceScore(declaration.getOverallComplianceScore())
                .compliancePercentage(declaration.getCompliancePercentage())
                .signatureDate(declaration.getSignatureDate() != null ?
                        declaration.getSignatureDate().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .signedBy(declaration.getSignedBy())
                .digitalSignature(declaration.getDigitalSignature())
                .pdfPath(declaration.getPdfPath())
                .pdfGeneratedAt(declaration.getPdfGeneratedAt() != null ?
                        declaration.getPdfGeneratedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .status(declaration.getStatus())
                .assessmentId(declaration.getAssessment() != null ?
                        declaration.getAssessment().getIdxcomplianceassessment() : null)
                .createdAt(declaration.getCreatedAt() != null ?
                        declaration.getCreatedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .updatedAt(declaration.getUpdatedAt() != null ?
                        declaration.getUpdatedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .projectId(project != null ? project.getIdxproject() : null)
                .projectName(project != null ? project.getPrjname() : null)
                .build();
    }

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.conformity.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.ConformityDeclarationBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.ComplianceAssessmentBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.governance.ConformityDeclaration;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.ComplianceAssessment;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.*;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.ProjectRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.projects.Project;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para operaciones de Conformity Declaration
 * según EU AI Act Annex V (Art. 48)
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/projects - Lista proyectos con declaraciones
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/manager - Datos del manager
 * - POST /api/v1/conformity-declaration - Crear declaración
 * - POST /api/v1/conformity-declaration/sign - Firmar declaración
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/{id} - Obtener por ID
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/project/{projectId} - Por proyecto
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/{id}/pdf - Descargar PDF
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/conformity-declaration")
@Tag(name = "Conformity Declaration", description = "Operaciones para EU Declaration of Conformity (Art. 48 EU AI Act)")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class ConformityDeclarationController {

    private final ConformityDeclarationBusinessService declarationBusinessService;
    private final ComplianceAssessmentBusinessService assessmentBusinessService;
    private final ProjectRepository projectRepository;

    @GetMapping("/projects")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar proyectos con declaraciones de conformidad",
        description = "Obtiene una lista paginada de proyectos con información resumida de declaraciones de conformidad"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de proyectos obtenida exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto>> listProjects(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "20") int size,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String hasDeclarations,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        
        log.info("Listing projects with conformity declarations: page={}, size={}, hasDeclarations={}, search={}",
                page, size, hasDeclarations, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // Obtener todos los proyectos (simplificado, en producción usar paginación)
                List<Project> projects = projectRepository.findAll();
                
                // Filtrar por búsqueda
                if (search != null && !search.isEmpty()) {
                    projects = projects.stream()
                            .filter(p -> p.getPrjname() != null && 
                                    p.getPrjname().toLowerCase().contains(search.toLowerCase()))
                            .collect(Collectors.toList());
                }

                // Convertir a DTOs con estadísticas
                List<ConformityDeclarationProjectSummaryDto> projectDtos = projects.stream()
                        .map(this::convertToProjectSummaryDto)
                        .filter(dto -> {
                            // Filtrar por hasDeclarations
                            if (hasDeclarations == null || hasDeclarations.isEmpty() || "all".equals(hasDeclarations)) {
                                return true;
                            }
                            boolean hasDecls = dto.getHasDeclarations();
                            return "true".equals(hasDeclarations) ? hasDecls : !hasDecls;
                        })
                        .skip(page * size)
                        .limit(size)
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                // Calcular estadísticas totales
                long totalProjects = projects.size();
                long projectsWithDeclarations = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getTotal() > 0 ? 1 : 0;
                        })
                        .sum();
                
                long totalDeclarations = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getTotal();
                        })
                        .sum();
                
                long totalSigned = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getSigned();
                        })
                        .sum();
                
                long totalDrafts = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getDrafts();
                        })
                        .sum();

                // Calcular paginación
                int totalElements = projects.size();
                int totalPages = (int) Math.ceil((double) totalElements / size);

                ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto response = 
                        ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto.builder()
                                .projects(projectDtos)
                                .statistics(ConformityDeclarationProjectsStatisticsDto.builder()
                                        .totalProjects(totalProjects)
                                        .projectsWithDeclarations(projectsWithDeclarations)
                                        .totalDeclarations(totalDeclarations)
                                        .totalSigned(totalSigned)
                                        .totalDrafts(totalDrafts)
                                        .build())
                                .pagination(ConformityDeclarationPaginationDto.builder()
                                        .page(page)
                                        .size(size)
                                        .totalPages(totalPages)
                                        .totalElements((long) totalElements)
                                        .build())
                                .build();

                return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error listing projects with conformity declarations", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/manager")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener datos del manager de declaraciones",
        description = "Retorna los datos completos para el manager de declaraciones de un proyecto"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Datos del manager obtenidos exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "projectId es requerido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Proyecto no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto>> getManagerData(
            @RequestParam Long projectId) {
        
        log.info("Getting manager data for project: {}", projectId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // Obtener proyecto
                Project project = projectRepository.findById(projectId)
                        .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Project not found: " + projectId));

                // Obtener assessments del proyecto
                List<ComplianceAssessment> assessments = assessmentBusinessService.getAllAssessments()
                        .stream()
                        .filter(a -> a.getProject() != null && 
                                a.getProject().getIdxproject().equals(projectId))
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                // Obtener declaraciones del proyecto
                List<ConformityDeclaration> declarations = 
                        declarationBusinessService.getDeclarationsByProject(projectId);

                // Convertir assessments a DTOs
                List<ComplianceAssessmentDto> assessmentDtos = assessments.stream()
                        .map(this::convertAssessmentToDto)
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                // Convertir declaraciones a DTOs
                List<ConformityDeclarationDto> declarationDtos = declarations.stream()
                        .map(decl -> convertDeclarationToDto(decl, project))
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto data = 
                        ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto.builder()
                                .projectId(projectId)
                                .projectName(project.getPrjname())
                                .assessments(assessmentDtos)
                                .declarations(declarationDtos)
                                .preview(null) // Se genera cuando se selecciona un assessment
                                .build();

                return ResponseEntity.ok(data);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting manager data for project: {}", projectId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping
    @Operation(
        summary = "Crear nueva declaración de conformidad",
        description = "Crea una nueva declaración de conformidad basada en un assessment"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Declaración creada exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationDto>> createDeclaration(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<CreateConformityDeclarationRequestDto> requestMono) {
        
        return requestMono
                .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Creating conformity declaration for assessment: {}", 
                        request.getAssessmentId()))
                .flatMap(request -> {
                    if (request.getAssessmentId() == null) {
                        log.warn("Assessment ID is required");
                        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<ConformityDeclarationDto>badRequest().build());
                    }

                    return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                            // Obtener assessment para obtener información del proyecto
                            ComplianceAssessment assessment = assessmentBusinessService
                                    .getAssessmentById(request.getAssessmentId());
                            if (assessment == null) {
                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Assessment not found: " + request.getAssessmentId());
                            }

                            Project project = assessment.getProject();
                            if (project == null) {
                                throw new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Assessment has no associated project");
                            }

                            // Crear declaración
                            ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                                    .createDeclaration(
                                            request.getAssessmentId(),
                                            request.getProviderName() != null ? request.getProviderName() : 
                                                    "Provider Name",
                                            request.getAiSystemName() != null ? request.getAiSystemName() : 
                                                    "AI System Name");

                            // Actualizar campos adicionales si se proporcionan
                            if (request.getProviderAddress() != null) {
                                declaration.setProviderAddress(request.getProviderAddress());
                            }
                            if (request.getProviderCountry() != null) {
                                declaration.setProviderCountry(request.getProviderCountry());
                            }
                            if (request.getProviderContact() != null) {
                                declaration.setProviderContact(request.getProviderContact());
                            }
                            if (request.getAiSystemType() != null) {
                                declaration.setAiSystemType(request.getAiSystemType());
                            }
                            if (request.getAiSystemVersion() != null) {
                                declaration.setAiSystemVersion(request.getAiSystemVersion());
                            }
                            if (request.getIntendedPurpose() != null) {
                                declaration.setIntendedPurpose(request.getIntendedPurpose());
                            }
                            if (request.getRiskCategory() != null) {
                                declaration.setRiskCategory(request.getRiskCategory());
                            }

                            // Convertir a DTO
                            ConformityDeclarationDto dto = convertDeclarationToDto(declaration, project);
                            return ResponseEntity.ok(dto);
                        })
                        .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic());
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error creating conformity declaration", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/sign")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Firmar declaración de conformidad",
        description = "Firma una declaración de conformidad en estado DRAFT"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Declaración firmada exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido o declaración no está en DRAFT"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Declaración no encontrada"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationDto>> signDeclaration(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<SignConformityDeclarationRequestDto> requestMono) {
        
        return requestMono
                .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Signing conformity declaration: {} by: {}", 
                        request.getDeclarationId(), request.getSignedBy()))
                .flatMap(request -> {
                    if (request.getDeclarationId() == null) {
                        log.warn("Declaration ID is required");
                        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<ConformityDeclarationDto>badRequest().build());
                    }

                    return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                            // Firmar declaración
                            ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                                    .signDeclaration(
                                            request.getDeclarationId(),
                                            request.getSignedBy(),
                                            request.getDigitalSignature());

                            // Obtener proyecto desde el assessment
                            Project project = declaration.getAssessment() != null ? 
                                    declaration.getAssessment().getProject() : null;

                            // Convertir a DTO
                            ConformityDeclarationDto dto = convertDeclarationToDto(declaration, project);
                            return ResponseEntity.ok(dto);
                        })
                        .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic());
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error signing conformity declaration", error);
                    if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.badRequest().build());
                    }
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{declarationId}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener declaración por ID",
        description = "Retorna una declaración de conformidad por su ID"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(

        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationDto>> getDeclarationById(
            @PathVariable Long declarationId) {
        
        log.info("Getting conformity declaration: {}", declarationId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                        .getDeclarationById(declarationId)
                        .orElse(null);
                if (declaration == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Declaration not found: " + declarationId);
                }

                Project project = declaration.getAssessment() != null ?

                ConformityDeclarationDto dto = convertDeclarationToDto(declaration, project);
                return ResponseEntity.ok(dto);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting conformity declaration: {}", declarationId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/project/{projectId}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener declaraciones por proyecto",
        description = "Retorna todas las declaraciones de conformidad de un proyecto"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de declaraciones obtenida exitosamente"
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<ConformityDeclarationDto>>> getDeclarationsByProject(
            @PathVariable Long projectId) {
        
        log.info("Getting conformity declarations for project: {}", projectId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // Obtener proyecto
                Project project = projectRepository.findById(projectId)
                        .orElse(null);

                // Obtener declaraciones
                List<ConformityDeclaration> declarations = 
                        declarationBusinessService.getDeclarationsByProject(projectId);

                // Convertir a DTOs
                List<ConformityDeclarationDto> dtos = declarations.stream()
                        .map(decl -> convertDeclarationToDto(decl, project))
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                return ResponseEntity.ok(dtos);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting declarations for project: {}", projectId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{declarationId}/pdf")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Descargar PDF de declaración",
        description = "Descarga el PDF generado de una declaración de conformidad"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "PDF descargado exitosamente"
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Declaración no encontrada o PDF no generado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<byte[]>> downloadDeclarationPdf(
            @PathVariable Long declarationId) {
        
        log.info("Downloading PDF for conformity declaration: {}", declarationId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                        .getDeclarationById(declarationId)
                        .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Declaration not found: " + declarationId));

                if (declaration.getPdfPath() == null || declaration.getPdfPath().isEmpty()) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "PDF not generated for declaration: " + declarationId);
                }

                // TODO: Implementar lectura del archivo PDF desde el path
                // Por ahora retornamos un array vacío
                byte[] pdfBytes = new byte[0];
                
                return ResponseEntity.ok()
                        .header("Content-Type", "application/pdf")
                        .header("Content-Disposition", 
                                "attachment; filename=declaration_" + declarationId + ".pdf")
                        .body(pdfBytes);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error downloading PDF for declaration: {}", declarationId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException || error instanceof IllegalStateException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    private ConformityDeclarationProjectSummaryDto convertToProjectSummaryDto(Project project) {
        ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(project.getIdxproject());

        // Obtener última declaración
        ConformityDeclaration lastDeclaration = declarationBusinessService
                .getDeclarationsByProject(project.getIdxproject())
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);

        return ConformityDeclarationProjectSummaryDto.builder()
                .projectId(project.getIdxproject())
                .projectName(project.getPrjname())
                .description(project.getPrjdescription())
                .totalDeclarations(stats.getTotal().intValue())
                .signedDeclarations(stats.getSigned().intValue())
                .draftDeclarations(stats.getDrafts().intValue())
                .latestDeclarationDate(lastDeclaration != null && lastDeclaration.getCreatedAt() != null ?
                        lastDeclaration.getCreatedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .latestDeclarationStatus(lastDeclaration != null ? lastDeclaration.getStatus() : null)
                .latestDeclarationVersion(lastDeclaration != null ? lastDeclaration.getAiSystemVersion() : null)
                .hasDeclarations(stats.getTotal() > 0)
                .build();
    }

    private ComplianceAssessmentDto convertAssessmentToDto(ComplianceAssessment assessment) {
        ComplianceAssessmentDto dto = new ComplianceAssessmentDto();
        dto.setIdxcomplianceassessment(assessment.getIdxcomplianceassessment());
        dto.setIdxproject(assessment.getProject() != null ? 
                assessment.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setComassessmenttype(assessment.getComassessmenttype());
        dto.setComassessmentdate(assessment.getComassessmentdate() != null ?
                assessment.getComassessmentdate().toLocalDateTime() : null);
        dto.setComassessmentname(assessment.getComassessmentname());
        dto.setComoverallscore(assessment.getComoverallscore());
        dto.setComreadyforcertification(assessment.getComreadyforcertification());
        return dto;
    }

    private ConformityDeclarationDto convertDeclarationToDto(ConformityDeclaration declaration, 
                                                             Project project) {
        return ConformityDeclarationDto.builder()
                .idxDeclaration(declaration.getIdxDeclaration())
                .providerName(declaration.getProviderName())
                .providerAddress(declaration.getProviderAddress())
                .providerCountry(declaration.getProviderCountry())
                .providerContact(declaration.getProviderContact())
                .aiSystemName(declaration.getAiSystemName())
                .aiSystemType(declaration.getAiSystemType())
                .aiSystemVersion(declaration.getAiSystemVersion())
                .intendedPurpose(declaration.getIntendedPurpose())
                .riskCategory(declaration.getRiskCategory())
                .conformityBasis(declaration.getConformityBasis())
                .appliedStandards(declaration.getAppliedStandards())
                .harmonizedStandards(declaration.getHarmonizedStandards())
                .art9RiskManagement(declaration.getArt9RiskManagement())
                .art10DataGovernance(declaration.getArt10DataGovernance())
                .art11Documentation(declaration.getArt11Documentation())
                .art12RecordKeeping(declaration.getArt12RecordKeeping())
                .art13Transparency(declaration.getArt13Transparency())
                .art14HumanOversight(declaration.getArt14HumanOversight())
                .art15Accuracy(declaration.getArt15Accuracy())
                .overallComplianceScore(declaration.getOverallComplianceScore())
                .compliancePercentage(declaration.getCompliancePercentage())
                .signatureDate(declaration.getSignatureDate() != null ?
                        declaration.getSignatureDate().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .signedBy(declaration.getSignedBy())
                .digitalSignature(declaration.getDigitalSignature())
                .pdfPath(declaration.getPdfPath())
                .pdfGeneratedAt(declaration.getPdfGeneratedAt() != null ?
                        declaration.getPdfGeneratedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .status(declaration.getStatus())
                .assessmentId(declaration.getAssessment() != null ?
                        declaration.getAssessment().getIdxcomplianceassessment() : null)
                .createdAt(declaration.getCreatedAt() != null ?
                        declaration.getCreatedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .updatedAt(declaration.getUpdatedAt() != null ?
                        declaration.getUpdatedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .projectId(project != null ? project.getIdxproject() : null)
                .projectName(project != null ? project.getPrjname() : null)
                .build();
    }
}
