```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.conformity.controller;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.ConformityDeclarationBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance.ComplianceAssessmentBusinessService;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.governance.ConformityDeclaration;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.compliance.ComplianceAssessment;
import com.codeflowx.govern.nocode.dtos.compliance.*;
import com.codeflowx.govern.repository.compliance.ProjectRepository;
import com.codeflowx.govern.entity.projects.Project;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.Operation;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Content;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media.Schema;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponses;
import io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.tags.Tag;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import reactor.core.publisher.Mono;
import reactor.core.scheduler.Schedulers;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * REST Controller reactivo para operaciones de Conformity Declaration
 * según EU AI Act Annex V (Art. 48)
 *
 * Endpoints:
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/projects - Lista proyectos con declaraciones
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/manager - Datos del manager
 * - POST /api/v1/conformity-declaration - Crear declaración
 * - POST /api/v1/conformity-declaration/sign - Firmar declaración
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/{id} - Obtener por ID
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/project/{projectId} - Por proyecto
 * - GET /api/v1/conformity-declaration/{id}/pdf - Descargar PDF
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/conformity-declaration")
@Tag(name = "Conformity Declaration", description = "Operaciones para EU Declaration of Conformity (Art. 48 EU AI Act)")
@RequiredArgsConstructor
@Slf4j
public class ConformityDeclarationController {

    private final ConformityDeclarationBusinessService declarationBusinessService;
    private final ComplianceAssessmentBusinessService assessmentBusinessService;
    private final ProjectRepository projectRepository;

    @GetMapping("/projects")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Listar proyectos con declaraciones de conformidad",
        description = "Obtiene una lista paginada de proyectos con información resumida de declaraciones de conformidad"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de proyectos obtenida exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto>> listProjects(
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "0") int page,
            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "20") int size,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String hasDeclarations,
            @RequestParam(required = false) String search) {
        
        log.info("Listing projects with conformity declarations: page={}, size={}, hasDeclarations={}, search={}",
                page, size, hasDeclarations, search);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // Obtener todos los proyectos (simplificado, en producción usar paginación)
                List<Project> projects = projectRepository.findAll();
                
                // Filtrar por búsqueda
                if (search != null && !search.isEmpty()) {
                    projects = projects.stream()
                            .filter(p -> p.getPrjname() != null && 
                                    p.getPrjname().toLowerCase().contains(search.toLowerCase()))
                            .collect(Collectors.toList());
                }

                // Convertir a DTOs con estadísticas
                List<ConformityDeclarationProjectSummaryDto> projectDtos = projects.stream()
                        .map(this::convertToProjectSummaryDto)
                        .filter(dto -> {
                            // Filtrar por hasDeclarations
                            if (hasDeclarations == null || hasDeclarations.isEmpty() || "all".equals(hasDeclarations)) {
                                return true;
                            }
                            boolean hasDecls = dto.getHasDeclarations();
                            return "true".equals(hasDeclarations) ? hasDecls : !hasDecls;
                        })
                        .skip(page * size)
                        .limit(size)
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                // Calcular estadísticas totales
                long totalProjects = projects.size();
                long projectsWithDeclarations = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getTotal() > 0 ? 1 : 0;
                        })
                        .sum();
                
                long totalDeclarations = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getTotal();
                        })
                        .sum();
                
                long totalSigned = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getSigned();
                        })
                        .sum();
                
                long totalDrafts = projects.stream()
                        .mapToLong(p -> {
                            ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                                    declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(p.getIdxproject());
                            return stats.getDrafts();
                        })
                        .sum();

                // Calcular paginación
                int totalElements = projects.size();
                int totalPages = (int) Math.ceil((double) totalElements / size);

                ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto response = 
                        ConformityDeclarationProjectsListResponseDto.builder()
                                .projects(projectDtos)
                                .statistics(ConformityDeclarationProjectsStatisticsDto.builder()
                                        .totalProjects(totalProjects)
                                        .projectsWithDeclarations(projectsWithDeclarations)
                                        .totalDeclarations(totalDeclarations)
                                        .totalSigned(totalSigned)
                                        .totalDrafts(totalDrafts)
                                        .build())
                                .pagination(ConformityDeclarationPaginationDto.builder()
                                        .page(page)
                                        .size(size)
                                        .totalPages(totalPages)
                                        .totalElements((long) totalElements)
                                        .build())
                                .build();

                return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error listing projects with conformity declarations", error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/manager")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener datos del manager de declaraciones",
        description = "Retorna los datos completos para el manager de declaraciones de un proyecto"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Datos del manager obtenidos exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "projectId es requerido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Proyecto no encontrado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto>> getManagerData(
            @RequestParam Long projectId) {
        
        log.info("Getting manager data for project: {}", projectId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // Obtener proyecto
                Project project = projectRepository.findById(projectId)
                        .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Project not found: " + projectId));

                // Obtener assessments del proyecto
                List<ComplianceAssessment> assessments = assessmentBusinessService.getAllAssessments()
                        .stream()
                        .filter(a -> a.getProject() != null && 
                                a.getProject().getIdxproject().equals(projectId))
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                // Obtener declaraciones del proyecto
                List<ConformityDeclaration> declarations = 
                        declarationBusinessService.getDeclarationsByProject(projectId);

                // Convertir assessments a DTOs
                List<ComplianceAssessmentDto> assessmentDtos = assessments.stream()
                        .map(this::convertAssessmentToDto)
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                // Convertir declaraciones a DTOs
                List<ConformityDeclarationDto> declarationDtos = declarations.stream()
                        .map(decl -> convertDeclarationToDto(decl, project))
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto data = 
                        ConformityDeclarationManagerDataDto.builder()
                                .projectId(projectId)
                                .projectName(project.getPrjname())
                                .assessments(assessmentDtos)
                                .declarations(declarationDtos)
                                .preview(null) // Se genera cuando se selecciona un assessment
                                .build();

                return ResponseEntity.ok(data);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting manager data for project: {}", projectId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @PostMapping
    @Operation(
        summary = "Crear nueva declaración de conformidad",
        description = "Crea una nueva declaración de conformidad basada en un assessment"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Declaración creada exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationDto>> createDeclaration(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<CreateConformityDeclarationRequestDto> requestMono) {
        
        return requestMono
                .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Creating conformity declaration for assessment: {}", 
                        request.getAssessmentId()))
                .flatMap(request -> {
                    if (request.getAssessmentId() == null) {
                        log.warn("Assessment ID is required");
                        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<ConformityDeclarationDto>badRequest().build());
                    }

                    return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                            // Obtener assessment para obtener información del proyecto
                            ComplianceAssessment assessment = assessmentBusinessService
                                    .getAssessmentById(request.getAssessmentId());
                            if (assessment == null) {
                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Assessment not found: " + request.getAssessmentId());
                            }

                            Project project = assessment.getProject();
                            if (project == null) {
                                throw new IllegalStateException(
                                        "Assessment has no associated project");
                            }

                            // Crear declaración
                            ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                                    .createDeclaration(
                                            request.getAssessmentId(),
                                            request.getProviderName() != null ? request.getProviderName() : 
                                                    "Provider Name",
                                            request.getAiSystemName() != null ? request.getAiSystemName() : 
                                                    "AI System Name");

                            // Actualizar campos adicionales si se proporcionan
                            if (request.getProviderAddress() != null) {
                                declaration.setProviderAddress(request.getProviderAddress());
                            }
                            if (request.getProviderCountry() != null) {
                                declaration.setProviderCountry(request.getProviderCountry());
                            }
                            if (request.getProviderContact() != null) {
                                declaration.setProviderContact(request.getProviderContact());
                            }
                            if (request.getAiSystemType() != null) {
                                declaration.setAiSystemType(request.getAiSystemType());
                            }
                            if (request.getAiSystemVersion() != null) {
                                declaration.setAiSystemVersion(request.getAiSystemVersion());
                            }
                            if (request.getIntendedPurpose() != null) {
                                declaration.setIntendedPurpose(request.getIntendedPurpose());
                            }
                            if (request.getRiskCategory() != null) {
                                declaration.setRiskCategory(request.getRiskCategory());
                            }

                            // Convertir a DTO
                            ConformityDeclarationDto dto = convertDeclarationToDto(declaration, project);
                            return ResponseEntity.ok(dto);
                        })
                        .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic());
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error creating conformity declaration", error);
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @PostMapping("/sign")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Firmar declaración de conformidad",
        description = "Firma una declaración de conformidad en estado DRAFT"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Declaración firmada exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "400", description = "Request inválido o declaración no está en DRAFT"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Declaración no encontrada"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationDto>> signDeclaration(
            @Valid @RequestBody Mono<SignConformityDeclarationRequestDto> requestMono) {
        
        return requestMono
                .doOnNext(request -> log.info("Signing conformity declaration: {} by: {}", 
                        request.getDeclarationId(), request.getSignedBy()))
                .flatMap(request -> {
                    if (request.getDeclarationId() == null) {
                        log.warn("Declaration ID is required");
                        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.<ConformityDeclarationDto>badRequest().build());
                    }

                    return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                            // Firmar declaración
                            ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                                    .signDeclaration(
                                            request.getDeclarationId(),
                                            request.getSignedBy(),
                                            request.getDigitalSignature());

                            // Obtener proyecto desde el assessment
                            Project project = declaration.getAssessment() != null ? 
                                    declaration.getAssessment().getProject() : null;

                            // Convertir a DTO
                            ConformityDeclarationDto dto = convertDeclarationToDto(declaration, project);
                            return ResponseEntity.ok(dto);
                        })
                        .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic());
                })
                .onErrorResume(error -> {
                    log.error("Error signing conformity declaration", error);
                    if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                        return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.badRequest().build());
                    }
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
                });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{declarationId}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener declaración por ID",
        description = "Retorna una declaración de conformidad por su ID"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Declaración obtenida exitosamente",
            content = @Content(schema = @Schema(implementation = ConformityDeclarationDto.class))
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Declaración no encontrada"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<ConformityDeclarationDto>> getDeclarationById(
            @PathVariable Long declarationId) {
        
        log.info("Getting conformity declaration: {}", declarationId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                        .getDeclarationById(declarationId)
                        .orElse(null);
                if (declaration == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Declaration not found: " + declarationId);
                }

                Project project = declaration.getAssessment() != null ? 
                        declaration.getAssessment().getProject() : null;

                ConformityDeclarationDto dto = convertDeclarationToDto(declaration, project);
                return ResponseEntity.ok(dto);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting conformity declaration: {}", declarationId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/project/{projectId}")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Obtener declaraciones por proyecto",
        description = "Retorna todas las declaraciones de conformidad de un proyecto"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "Lista de declaraciones obtenida exitosamente"
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<List<ConformityDeclarationDto>>> getDeclarationsByProject(
            @PathVariable Long projectId) {
        
        log.info("Getting conformity declarations for project: {}", projectId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                // Obtener proyecto
                Project project = projectRepository.findById(projectId)
                        .orElse(null);

                // Obtener declaraciones
                List<ConformityDeclaration> declarations = 
                        declarationBusinessService.getDeclarationsByProject(projectId);

                // Convertir a DTOs
                List<ConformityDeclarationDto> dtos = declarations.stream()
                        .map(decl -> convertDeclarationToDto(decl, project))
                        .collect(Collectors.toList());

                return ResponseEntity.ok(dtos);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error getting declarations for project: {}", projectId, error);
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    @GetMapping("/{declarationId}/pdf")
    @Operation(
        summary = "Descargar PDF de declaración",
        description = "Descarga el PDF generado de una declaración de conformidad"
    )
    @ApiResponses({
        @ApiResponse(
            responseCode = "200",
            description = "PDF descargado exitosamente"
        ),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "404", description = "Declaración no encontrada o PDF no generado"),
        @ApiResponse(responseCode = "500", description = "Error interno del servidor")
    })
    public Mono<ResponseEntity<byte[]>> downloadDeclarationPdf(
            @PathVariable Long declarationId) {
        
        log.info("Downloading PDF for conformity declaration: {}", declarationId);

        return Mono.fromCallable(() -> {
                ConformityDeclaration declaration = declarationBusinessService
                        .getDeclarationById(declarationId)
                        .orElse(null);
                if (declaration == null) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Declaration not found: " + declarationId);
                }

                if (declaration.getPdfPath() == null || declaration.getPdfPath().isEmpty()) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException(
                            "PDF not generated for declaration: " + declarationId);
                }

                // TODO: Implementar lectura del archivo PDF desde el path
                // Por ahora retornamos un array vacío
                byte[] pdfBytes = new byte[0];
                
                return ResponseEntity.ok()
                        .header("Content-Type", "application/pdf")
                        .header("Content-Disposition", 
                                "attachment; filename=declaration_" + declarationId + ".pdf")
                        .body(pdfBytes);
            })
            .subscribeOn(Schedulers.boundedElastic())
            .onErrorResume(error -> {
                log.error("Error downloading PDF for declaration: {}", declarationId, error);
                if (error instanceof IllegalArgumentException || error instanceof IllegalStateException) {
                    return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
                }
                return Mono.just(ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).build());
            });
    }

    private ConformityDeclarationProjectSummaryDto convertToProjectSummaryDto(Project project) {
        ConformityDeclarationBusinessService.DeclarationStatistics stats = 
                declarationBusinessService.getStatisticsByProject(project.getIdxproject());

        // Obtener última declaración
        ConformityDeclaration lastDeclaration = declarationBusinessService
                .getDeclarationsByProject(project.getIdxproject())
                .stream()
                .findFirst()
                .orElse(null);

        return ConformityDeclarationProjectSummaryDto.builder()
                .projectId(project.getIdxproject())
                .projectName(project.getPrjname())
                .description(project.getPrjdescription())
                .totalDeclarations(stats.getTotal().intValue())
                .signedDeclarations(stats.getSigned().intValue())
                .draftDeclarations(stats.getDrafts().intValue())
                .latestDeclarationDate(lastDeclaration != null && lastDeclaration.getCreatedAt() != null ?
                        lastDeclaration.getCreatedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .latestDeclarationStatus(lastDeclaration != null ? lastDeclaration.getStatus() : null)
                .latestDeclarationVersion(lastDeclaration != null ? lastDeclaration.getAiSystemVersion() : null)
                .hasDeclarations(stats.getTotal() > 0)
                .build();
    }

    private ComplianceAssessmentDto convertAssessmentToDto(ComplianceAssessment assessment) {
        ComplianceAssessmentDto dto = new ComplianceAssessmentDto();
        dto.setIdxcomplianceassessment(assessment.getIdxcomplianceassessment());
        dto.setIdxproject(assessment.getProject() != null ? 
                assessment.getProject().getIdxproject() : null);
        dto.setComassessmenttype(assessment.getComassessmenttype());
        dto.setComassessmentdate(assessment.getComassessmentdate() != null ?
                assessment.getComassessmentdate().toLocalDateTime() : null);
        dto.setComassessmentname(assessment.getComassessmentname());
        dto.setComoverallscore(assessment.getComoverallscore());
        dto.setComreadyforcertification(assessment.getComreadyforcertification());
        return dto;
    }

    private ConformityDeclarationDto convertDeclarationToDto(ConformityDeclaration declaration, 
                                                             Project project) {
        return ConformityDeclarationDto.builder()
                .idxDeclaration(declaration.getIdxDeclaration())
                .providerName(declaration.getProviderName())
                .providerAddress(declaration.getProviderAddress())
                .providerCountry(declaration.getProviderCountry())
                .providerContact(declaration.getProviderContact())
                .aiSystemName(declaration.getAiSystemName())
                .aiSystemType(declaration.getAiSystemType())
                .aiSystemVersion(declaration.getAiSystemVersion())
                .intendedPurpose(declaration.getIntendedPurpose())
                .riskCategory(declaration.getRiskCategory())
                .conformityBasis(declaration.getConformityBasis())
                .appliedStandards(declaration.getAppliedStandards())
                .harmonizedStandards(declaration.getHarmonizedStandards())
                .art9RiskManagement(declaration.getArt9RiskManagement())
                .art10DataGovernance(declaration.getArt10DataGovernance())
                .art11Documentation(declaration.getArt11Documentation())
                .art12RecordKeeping(declaration.getArt12RecordKeeping())
                .art13Transparency(declaration.getArt13Transparency())
                .art14HumanOversight(declaration.getArt14HumanOversight())
                .art15Accuracy(declaration.getArt15Accuracy())
                .overallComplianceScore(declaration.getOverallComplianceScore())
                .compliancePercentage(declaration.getCompliancePercentage())
                .signatureDate(declaration.getSignatureDate() != null ?
                        declaration.getSignatureDate().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .signedBy(declaration.getSignedBy())
                .digitalSignature(declaration.getDigitalSignature())
                .pdfPath(declaration.getPdfPath())
                .pdfGeneratedAt(declaration.getPdfGeneratedAt() != null ?
                        declaration.getPdfGeneratedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .status(declaration.getStatus())
                .assessmentId(declaration.getAssessment() != null ?
                        declaration.getAssessment().getIdxcomplianceassessment() : null)
                .createdAt(declaration.getCreatedAt() != null ?
                        declaration.getCreatedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .updatedAt(declaration.getUpdatedAt() != null ?
                        declaration.getUpdatedAt().toLocalDateTime() : null)
                .projectId(project != null ? project.getIdxproject() : null)
                .projectName(project != null ? project.getPrjname() : null)
                .build();
    }
}
```

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { USE_MOCK, BFF_BASE_URL } from "@/app/config/mock";

const USE_MOCK_LOCAL = process.env.USE_MOCK === "true" || process.env.NODE_ENV === "development";

// Mock data para proyectos con declaraciones de conformidad
const mockProjects = [
  {
    projectId: 1,
    projectName: "Healthcare Diagnostics AI",
    description: "Sistema de diagnóstico médico con IA",
    totalDeclarations: 2,
    signedDeclarations: 1,
    draftDeclarations: 1,
    latestDeclarationDate: "2025-01-15T00:00:00Z",
    latestDeclarationStatus: "SIGNED",
    latestDeclarationVersion: "v1.2",
    hasDeclarations: true,
  },
  {
    projectId: 2,
    projectName: "Financial Fraud Detection",
    description: "Sistema de detección de fraude financiero",
    totalDeclarations: 1,
    signedDeclarations: 0,
    draftDeclarations: 1,
    latestDeclarationDate: "2025-01-14T00:00:00Z",
    latestDeclarationStatus: "DRAFT",
    latestDeclarationVersion: "v1.0",
    hasDeclarations: true,
  },
  {
    projectId: 3,
    projectName: "Manufacturing Quality Control",
    description: "Control de calidad en manufactura",
    totalDeclarations: 0,
    signedDeclarations: 0,
    draftDeclarations: 0,
    hasDeclarations: false,
  },
];

export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const searchParams = request.nextUrl.searchParams;
    const page = parseInt(searchParams.get("page") || "0");
    const size = parseInt(searchParams.get("size") || "20");
    const hasDeclarations = searchParams.get("hasDeclarations");
    const search = searchParams.get("search");

    if (USE_MOCK || USE_MOCK_LOCAL) {
      // Filtrar por hasDeclarations
      let filtered = mockProjects;
      if (hasDeclarations && hasDeclarations !== "all") {
        const hasDecls = hasDeclarations === "true";
        filtered = filtered.filter((p) => p.hasDeclarations === hasDecls);
      }

      // Filtrar por búsqueda
      if (search) {
        const searchLower = search.toLowerCase();
        filtered = filtered.filter(
          (p) =>
            p.projectName.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower) ||
            (p.description && p.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchLower))
        );
      }

      // Calcular estadísticas
      const totalProjects = filtered.length;
      const projectsWithDeclarations = filtered.filter((p) => p.hasDeclarations).length;
      const totalDeclarations = filtered.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.totalDeclarations, 0);
      const totalSigned = filtered.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.signedDeclarations, 0);
      const totalDrafts = filtered.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.draftDeclarations, 0);

      // Paginación
      const start = page * size;
      const end = start + size;
      const paginatedProjects = filtered.slice(start, end);
      const totalPages = Math.ceil(filtered.length / size);

      return NextResponse.json({
        success: true,
        data: {
          projects: paginatedProjects,
          pagination: {
            page,
            size,
            totalElements: filtered.length,
            totalPages,
          },
          statistics: {
            totalProjects,
            projectsWithDeclarations,
            totalDeclarations,
            totalSigned,
            totalDrafts,
          },
        },
      });
    }

    // Llamada real al backend
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.append("page", String(page));
    params.append("size", String(size));
    if (hasDeclarations && hasDeclarations !== "all") {
      params.append("hasDeclarations", hasDeclarations);
    }
    if (search) params.append("search", search);

    const response = await fetch(
      `${BFF_BASE_URL}/api/v1/conformity-declaration/projects?${params.toString()}`,
      {
        method: "GET",
        headers: {
          "Content-Type": "application/json",
        },
      }
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Backend responded with status ${response.status}`);
    }

    const data = await response.json();

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      data,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error fetching conformity declaration projects:", error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      {
        success: false,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to fetch projects",
      },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
```

```typescriptreact
    projectId: 2,
    projectName: "Manufacturing AI Project",
    system_name: "Manufacturing Quality Control",
    provider_name: "ManufacturingAI Solutions",
    declaration_date: "2025-01-14",
    status: "SIGNED",
    version: "v1.0",
  },
];

const mockPreview: DeclarationPreview = {
  providerName: "TechCorp Medical",
  systemName: "Healthcare Diagnostics AI",
  complianceScore: 87.5,
  articlesCompliance: "Art. 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15",
};

export default function ConformityDeclarationManagerPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const [data, setData] = useState<ConformityDeclarationData>({
    projectId: DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID,
    projectName: "",
    assessments: [],
    selectedAssessmentId: null,
    generating: false,
    preview: null,
    declarations: [],
  });

  // Obtener projectId de la URL o usar valor por defecto
  const getProjectId = (): number => {
    if (searchParams) {
      const projectIdParam = searchParams.get("projectId");
      if (projectIdParam) {
        const parsed = parseInt(projectIdParam, 10);
        if (!isNaN(parsed)) {
          return parsed;
        }
      }
    }
    return DEFAULT_PROJECT_ID;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [searchParams]);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      const projectId = getProjectId();
      
      const response = await fetch(`/api/governance/compliance/conformity-declaration/manager?projectId=${projectId}`);
      
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Failed to load data");
      }

      const result = await response.json();
      
      if (result.success && result.data) {
        const managerData = result.data;
        setData({
          projectId: managerData.projectId || projectId,
          projectName: managerData.projectName || `Project ${projectId}`,
          assessments: managerData.assessments?.map((a: any) => ({
            idxcomplianceassessment: a.idxcomplianceassessment || a.idxcomplianceassessment,
            assessmentname: a.assessmentname || a.comassessmentname || "Assessment",
            projectId: a.idxproject || projectId,
            projectName: managerData.projectName,
          })) || [],
          selectedAssessmentId: null,
          generating: false,
          preview: managerData.preview || null,
          declarations: managerData.declarations?.map((d: any) => ({
            id: d.idxDeclaration || d.id,
            projectId: d.projectId || projectId,
            projectName: d.projectName || managerData.projectName,
            system_name: d.aiSystemName || d.system_name || "System",
            provider_name: d.providerName || d.provider_name || "Provider",
            declaration_date: d.createdAt ? new Date(d.createdAt).toISOString().split("T")[0] : 
                             d.declaration_date || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
            status: d.status || "DRAFT",
            version: d.aiSystemVersion || d.version || "v1.0",
          })) || [],
        });
      } else {
        // Fallback a datos mock si falla
        const projectAssessments = mockAssessments.filter(a => a.projectId === projectId);
        const projectDeclarations = mockDeclarations.filter(d => d.projectId === projectId);
        const projectName = projectAssessments[0]?.projectName || projectDeclarations[0]?.projectName || `Project ${projectId}`;

        setData({
          projectId: projectId,
          projectName: projectName,
          assessments: projectAssessments,
          selectedAssessmentId: null,
          generating: false,
          preview: null,
          declarations: projectDeclarations,
        });
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading data:", error);
      // Fallback a datos mock en caso de error
      const projectId = getProjectId();
      const projectAssessments = mockAssessments.filter(a => a.projectId === projectId);
      const projectDeclarations = mockDeclarations.filter(d => d.projectId === projectId);
      const projectName = projectAssessments[0]?.projectName || projectDeclarations[0]?.projectName || `Project ${projectId}`;

      setData({
        projectId: projectId,
        projectName: projectName,
        assessments: projectAssessments,
        selectedAssessmentId: null,
        generating: false,
        preview: null,
        declarations: projectDeclarations,
      });
    }
  };

  const handleSelectAssessment = (assessmentId: number) => {
    // Simular preview basado en el assessment seleccionado
    setData({
      ...data,
      selectedAssessmentId: assessmentId,
      preview: mockPreview,
    });
  };

  const handleGenerateDeclaration = async () => {
    if (!data.selectedAssessmentId) return;

    try {
      setData({ ...data, generating: true });
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
      // Simular nueva declaración generada
      const existingDeclarationsCount = data.declarations.length;
      const newDeclaration: Declaration = {
        id: data.declarations.length > 0 ? Math.max(...data.declarations.map(d => d.id)) + 1 : 1,
        projectId: data.projectId,
        projectName: data.projectName,
        system_name: data.preview?.systemName || "New System",
        provider_name: data.preview?.providerName || "Provider",
        declaration_date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
        status: "DRAFT",
        version: `v1.${existingDeclarationsCount + 1}`,
      };
      setData({
        ...data,
        generating: false,
        declarations: [newDeclaration, ...data.declarations],
      });
      alert(t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.declarationGenerated", "Declaración generada exitosamente"));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error generating declaration:", error);
      setData({ ...data, generating: false });
    }
  };

  const handleSignDeclaration = async (declId: number) => {
    try {
      // TODO: Reemplazar con llamada real a API
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
      setData({
        ...data,
        declarations: data.declarations.map((decl) =>
          decl.id === declId ? { ...decl, status: "SIGNED" as const } : decl
        ),
      });
      alert(t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.declarationSigned", "Declaración firmada exitosamente"));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error signing declaration:", error);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadDeclaration = async (declId: number) => {
    try {
      // TODO: Reemplazar con descarga real
      alert(`${t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.downloading", "Descargando declaración")} ${declId}...`);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error downloading declaration:", error);
    }
  };

  const signedCount = data.declarations.filter((d) => d.status === "SIGNED").length;
  const draftCount = data.declarations.filter((d) => d.status === "DRAFT").length;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-hidden">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-blue-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-3/4 right-1/4 w-1 h-1 bg-purple-400/40 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-1000" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-cyan-400/35 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-500" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-full px-4 py-6 space-y-6">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                onClick={() => {
                  if (data.projectId) {
                    window.location.href = "/governance/compliance/conformity-declaration/projects";
                  } else {
                    window.location.href = "/governance/compliance/dashboard";
                  }
                }}
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                {t("common.back", "Volver")}
              </Button>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <Award className="w-8 h-8 text-indigo-500" />
                <div>
                  <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">
                    {t(
                      "governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.title",
                      "EU Declaration of Conformity Manager"
                    )}
                  </h1>
                  <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
                    {t(
                      "governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.subtitle",
                      "Gestión de declaraciones de conformidad según EU AI Act Annex V"
                    )}
                  </p>
                  {data.projectId && data.projectName && (
                    <div className="mt-2">
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                        {t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.project", "Proyecto")}: {data.projectName}
                      </Badge>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                        {t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.projectDeclarations", "Este proyecto puede tener múltiples declaraciones de conformidad (versiones, actualizaciones, etc.)")}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Información del Proyecto */}
            {data.projectName && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-4 rounded-lg border bg-card">
                <FolderOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                <div>
                  <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.project", "Proyecto")}
                  </div>
                  <div className="font-semibold text-lg">
                    {data.projectName} <span className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">(ID: {data.projectId})</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                    {t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.projectDeclarations", "Este proyecto puede tener múltiples declaraciones de conformidad (versiones, actualizaciones, etc.)")}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Estadísticas en el header */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.totalDeclarations", "Total")}</div>
                <div className="font-semibold text-lg">{data.declarations.length}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.signed", "Firmadas")}</div>
                <div className="font-semibold text-lg text-green-600">{signedCount}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.drafts", "Borradores")}</div>
                <div className="font-semibold text-lg text-yellow-600">{draftCount}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.availableAssessments", "Assessments")}</div>
                <div className="font-semibold text-lg">{data.assessments.length}</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Selección y Generación */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          {/* Generate New Declaration */}
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.generateNew", "Generar Nueva Declaración")}</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2">
                  {t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.selectAssessmentRequired", "Seleccionar Assessment")} <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <select
                  value={data.selectedAssessmentId || ""}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    handleSelectAssessment(Number(e.target.value))
                  }
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md bg-background"
                >
                  <option value="">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.selectAssessmentPlaceholder", "Selecciona un assessment conforme...")}</option>
                  {data.assessments.map((assessment) => (
                    <option
                      key={assessment.idxcomplianceassessment}
                      value={assessment.idxcomplianceassessment}
                    >
                      {assessment.assessmentname}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              <Button
                onClick={handleGenerateDeclaration}
                disabled={data.generating || !data.selectedAssessmentId}
                className="w-full"
              >
                {data.generating ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                    {t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.generating", "Generando...")}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Award className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                    {t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.generate", "Generar Declaración")}
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>

          {/* Declaration Preview */}
          <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50 hover:shadow-3xl transition-all duration-300">
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.declarationPreview", "Vista Previa de Declaración")}</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardBody>
              {data.preview ? (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-semibold">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.provider", "Proveedor")}:</span>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">{data.preview.providerName}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-semibold">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.aiSystem", "Sistema de IA")}:</span>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">{data.preview.systemName}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-semibold">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.complianceScore", "Score de Conformidad")}:</span>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">{data.preview.complianceScore}%</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-semibold">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.articles", "Artículos")}:</span>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">{data.preview.articlesCompliance}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">
                  {t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.selectAssessmentForPreview", "Selecciona un assessment para ver la vista previa")}
                </p>
              )}
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Lista de Declaraciones */}
        <Card className="backdrop-blur-md bg-background/60 border-border/50">
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <CardTitle>{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.existingDeclarations", "Declaraciones Existentes")}</CardTitle>
              <Button onClick={loadData} variant="outline" size="sm">
                <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardBody>
            {data.declarations.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-center text-muted-foreground py-8">
                {t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.noDeclarations", "Aún no hay declaraciones")}
              </p>
            ) : (
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b">
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.id", "ID")}</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.systemName", "Nombre del Sistema")}</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.version", "Versión")}</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.providerName", "Proveedor")}</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.date", "Fecha")}</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.status", "Estado")}</th>
                      <th className="text-left p-2">{t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.actions", "Acciones")}</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {data.declarations.map((decl) => (
                      <tr key={decl.id} className="border-b hover:bg-muted/50">
                        <td className="p-2">{decl.id}</td>
                        <td className="p-2">{decl.system_name}</td>
                        <td className="p-2">
                          <Badge variant="outline">{decl.version || "v1.0"}</Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2">{decl.provider_name}</td>
                        <td className="p-2">{decl.declaration_date}</td>
                        <td className="p-2">
                          <Badge
                            className={
                              decl.status === "SIGNED"
                                ? "bg-green-100 text-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/20 dark:text-green-300"
                                : "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 dark:bg-yellow-900/20 dark:text-yellow-300"
                            }
                          >
                            {decl.status === "SIGNED" ? (
                              <>
                                <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1 inline" />
                                {t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.signedStatus", "FIRMADA")}
                              </>
                            ) : (
                              <>
                                <Clock className="w-3 h-3 mr-1 inline" />
                                {t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.draftStatus", "BORRADOR")}
                              </>
                            )}
                          </Badge>
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-2">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            {decl.status === "DRAFT" && (
                              <Button
                                onClick={() => handleSignDeclaration(decl.id)}
                                variant="outline"
                                size="sm"
                                title={t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.sign", "Firmar")}
                              >
                                <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </Button>
                            )}
                            <Button
                              onClick={() => handleDownloadDeclaration(decl.id)}
                              variant="outline"
                              size="sm"
                              title={t("governance.compliance.conformity.conformityDeclaration.download", "Descargar PDF")}
                            >
                              <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardBody>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
